plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: DSH plugin: switch the session terminal tool from pwsh to the local Git Bash on Windows.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-terminal-tool

在 Windows 上把模型的终端工具从 **pwsh** 换成 **本机 Git Bash** 的 DSH 插件。

设计取向：**一个开关、所有 preset 跟随、不动 preset 文件、不接管全局 `ctx.shell`**。默认 `dialect: pwsh`，装上去什么都不变；改成 `bash` 后，**新会话**拿到 `bash` 工具、`pwsh` 从该会话的工具目录里消失，已开的会话保持原状。

---

## 为什么要这个插件

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的平台组合在 Windows 上是互斥的：

```yaml
- id: bash-sandbox
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
  disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
- id: pwsh-sandbox
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
  disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
- id: tool-bash          # 同样的平台断言
- id: tool-pwsh
```

`ctx.shell` 是单实例服务（同一 context 内加载第二个会抛错），所以 Windows 上根本没有 bash 执行器，`bash` 工具也不存在。想用 Git Bash 只有三条路：

| 路线 | 代价 |
|---|---|
| 改 `dsh-base` / profile patch 的平台断言 | 要动第一方组合，重启，且只影响那一个平面 |
| 自研 PTY / 自研工具 | 重写 60KB+ 的工具契约，容易与官方行为漂移 |
| **本插件：会话级隔离替换** | 只在新会话的 `isolate('shell')` 子树里注入执行器，宿主平面不动 |

本插件选第三条。

---

## 工作原理

插件本身不实现终端。它做四件事，全部复用第一方组件：

1. **执行器**：`GitBashExecutor extends LocalBashExecutor`，只改两处——
   - `execute()` 用配置的 `bash.exe` 绝对路径组 `[bash, -c, command]`（基类硬编码 `"bash"`，在 Windows 上会命中 `System32\bash.exe`，那是 WSL 启动器）；
   - `resolve()` 注入 `PATH`（`spawnSpec` 里 `spec.env` 是唯一能塞 PATH 的位置）。

   超时、输出收集与溢出、abort 分类、`dshEnv` 合并、结果整形全部继承，行为与官方 bash 执行器一致。

2. **工具本体**：直接挂官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash`。前台/后台、超时转后台、`sandbox_permissions` 升级、会话 cwd、工具卡片、退出码标记，官方自带。

3. **会话级替换**（`src/replace.ts`，在 `agent/created` 里执行）：
   ```
   shellCtx = agentCtx.isolate('shell')       // 该 agent 私有的 shell realm
   shellCtx.plugin(GitBashExecutor, {...})    // 只在这个子树里可见
   shellCtx.plugin(ToolBash, {...})           // 注册出的 bash 落在 agent 自己的工具层
   agentCtx.tools.restrict({ deny: ['pwsh'] })          // 只过滤「继承来的」工具
   agentCtx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'tool:pwsh', text: '' })  // 空文本=渲染时丢弃
   ```
   四步都登记在 `agentCtx` 上，会话结束由 cordis 逆序释放；中途失败则逆序回滚，会话退化为原样。

4. **配置**：所有字段 `.volatile()`，Host 侧由 `dsh-settings` 投影成可写 namespace；**客户端半区**（`lib/client.js`）再用官方 `configForms` 服务把同一份值渲染成 **设置 → 通用 → 终端工具** 的一行，写回仍落在 profile 的 patch 层。不加客户端半区时，Host 侧值虽然可写，但设置页里没有任何 UI 入口。

### 关键设计约束（为什么不那么做）

- **不接管全局 `ctx.shell`**：那会让所有会话（包括没选 bash 的）跟着变，并且与宿主平台的执行器冲突。
- **不编辑 preset**：`preset-standard` 在 profile 里是完整快照，改它等于接管用户的组合文件，且升级会被覆盖。
- **只对新会话生效**：工具与 prompt 是会话创建时装配的，运行中换不掉——这是 DSH 的语义，不是插件的取舍。
- **`restrict` 只过滤继承层**：官方文档明确 "never what its OWN layer registers"，所以从 agent scope 调 `restrict({deny:['pwsh']})` 恰好只隐藏 preset 带进来的 `pwsh`，不影响本层注册的 `bash`。
- **不绕过沙箱**：受限模式下仍走 `ctx.sandbox.confine()`，起不来就如实把官方错误交给模型。

---

## 安装

### 前置条件

- Windows + DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 及以上（本插件在该版本上开发与验证）
- 本机已装 Git for Windows（或 MSYS2 / Cygwin）
- 想用受限沙箱的话，见下面「已知限制」第 3 条

### 步骤

```powershell
# 1. 构建（产物在 lib/）
git clone https://github.com/road-kid/dsh-terminal-tool.git
cd dsh-terminal-tool
npm install
npm run check        # typecheck + build + contractcheck + selftest + integration

# 2. 装进 profile（本机 profile 为 desktop）
#    用插件管理器从本地目录安装：
#    plugin_manager install_bundle → target = 本仓库的绝对路径
npm pack
# 或把 tarball / 目录放进 profile 的依赖里，例如
#   C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json
```

插件包自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`，profile 的组合层会读取它并插入：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: terminal-tool
      name: dsh-terminal-tool
      disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
```

**安装或升级后必须重启 DSH**：运行中插入的 row 只进组合树，插件的 `apply` 不会被调用。

### 启用

重启后打开 **设置 → 通用**，底部会多出一行 **终端工具**（客户端半区注册的 `settings.general.item` 行）：

```
终端工具
[PowerShell（pwsh）] [Git Bash（bash）]
Git Bash 路径  [__________________________]  [自动发现]
更改对新会话生效（运行中的会话保持启动时的选择）。
```

- 两枚胶囊按钮切换 `dialect`，**默认 `pwsh`**：装插件本身不改变任何行为。
- 选 `bash` 后才出现路径行。「自动发现」会扫一遍本机 Git Bash，把可用路径持久化进 `bashCandidates`；候选多于一条时输入框变成下拉。
- 已经选好的路径**不会**被后续扫描改写（除非它已失效）。
- 挂载时**不扫描、不写配置**：扫描只在点「自动发现」时发生，`/state` 只读配置。

设置行通过两条只读 `/api` 路由取数（写入仍走 `configForms`，落 profile patch 层）：

| 路由 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `POST /api/dsh-terminal-tool/state` | 平台、设置可用性、当前值、能力探测。**不扫描**，所以打开设置是瞬时的 |
| `POST /api/dsh-terminal-tool/discover` | 用户点「自动发现」时才调用，返回全部可用候选 |

Config 字段（设置行只暴露前三个；其余仍可直接写 profile patch）：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `dialect` | `pwsh`（默认，行为不变）/ `bash` |
| `bashPath` | 显式 bash.exe 绝对路径；留空 = 自动发现 |
| `bashCandidates` | 上一次「自动发现」的可用路径（也接受手填的安装根目录） |
| `autoDiscover` | 会话装配时 `bashPath` 为空是否自动发现 |
| `discoverTimeoutMs` | 一次发现的上限（只 stat 文件，不 spawn） |
| `loginShell` | 传 `-l`，读取登录 profile |
| `extraPath` | 追加到子进程 PATH 的目录 |
| `pythonUtf8` | 导出 `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` |
| `timeoutMs` / `maxTimeoutMs` / `maxOutputBytes` / `maxSpillBytes` / `graceMs` | 继承自官方 bash 执行器的同名字段 |

把 `dialect` 改成 `bash`，**新建会话**即可看到工具目录里是 `bash` 而不再是 `pwsh`。已开的会话不受影响。

---

## 自动发现顺序

`bashPath` 为空且 `autoDiscover` 为真时，按下列顺序找，命中即止：

1. `bashCandidates` 里的每一项（展开为 `bin\bash.exe` / `usr\bin\bash.exe`）
2. 注册表 `HKLM\SOFTWARE\GitForWindows` 的 `InstallPath`
3. `%ProgramFiles%\Git`、`%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Git`、`%LocalAppData%\Programs\Git`
4. `%ProgramFiles%\MSYS2`、`C:\msys64`、`%LocalAppData%\MSYS2`
5. `%SystemDrive%\cygwin64`、`%SystemDrive%\cygwin`
6. PATH 上 `git.exe` 反推（`<root>\bin\bash.exe`）

**WSL 被硬排除**：`C:\Windows\System32\bash.exe` 和 `WindowsApps\bash.exe` 都不是 Git Bash，交给执行器会得到另一个操作系统和另一套文件系统。

发现只做文件系统探测（`statSync`）+ 一次异步 `reg.exe query`，**不会 spawn `bash --version`**——宿主在 `agent/created` 里串行派发事件，同步 spawn 会卡住整个进程。

---

## PATH 组装

执行时子进程 PATH = `工具链 bin` → `usr\bin` → `bin` → `usr\local\bin` → `extraPath` → **宿主 PATH**。

顺序是有意的：MSYS2 的 `git`/`ls`/`grep` 必须赢过 Windows 上的同名同源工具，而宿主 PATH 必须保留，否则 `node`/`python` 等原生命令会消失。去重按「小写 + 去尾分隔符 + `/`→`\`」归一化。

---

## 排障

诊断日志（每次会话一行）：

```
%TEMP%\dsh-terminal-tool.log
```

用 `DSH_TERMINAL_TOOL_DIAG_FILE` 覆盖路径。典型行：

```
[2026-10-18T02:10:00.000Z] ok session=... bash=C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe source=registry path=4 entries
[2026-10-18T02:10:00.000Z] skip session=... reason=bash-not-found: C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe: file does not exist
[2026-10-18T02:10:00.000Z] skip session=... reason=already-replaced
```

`reason` 取值：`not-win32` / `dialect-pwsh` / `no-agent-context` / `already-replaced` / `bash-not-found` / `missing-service` / `mount-failed`。

排查思路：

1. **工具目录还是 pwsh** → 先看日志有没有 `ok session=`。没有 `ok` 就按 `reason` 走。
2. **`bash-not-found`** → 把 `bashPath` 显式指到 `C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe` 试试。
3. **`mount-failed`** → `detail` 里是 cordis 的原始错误（常见是配置校验或服务缺失）。
4. **bash 能出现但命令报错** → 见「已知限制」第 3、4、5 条。

插件永不因自身问题让会话创建失败：`agent/created` 是串行派发的，监听器抛错会让 agent 注册失败，所以整个监听体是防御式的，任何异常只落日志。

---

## 已知限制

1. **仅 Windows**。非 Windows 上 patch 行的 `disabled` 为真，插件根本不加载。
2. **只对新会话生效**。工具与 prompt 段是会话创建时装配的，运行中无法替换。
3. **受限沙箱下 Git Bash 起不来**。`read-only` / `workspace-write` 用受限令牌执行，MSYS2 无法创建 `BaseNamedObjects`：
   ```
   bash.exe: *** fatal error - NtCreateDirectoryObject(\BaseNamedObjects\msys-2.0S5-…): 0xC0000022
   exit -1073741502
   ```
   需要 `danger-full-access`。**这是宿主沙箱行为，与插件无关**，插件不会绕过它。
4. **原生 Windows 程序输出可能乱码**。`cmd`/`tasklist`/`powershell` 按 ANSI 代码页（中文系统为 936）写管道，DSH 按 UTF-8 解码 → 中文乱码；`chcp 65001` 无效。仅 Python 可用 `PYTHONIOENCODING` 缓解（默认已开）。
5. **`cmd /c` 会被 MSYS 参数改写**，需写 `cmd //c` 或设 `MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'`。
6. **首次安装必须重启 DSH**（理由见「安装」）。
7. **`minimal` preset 的持久 shell 会退化为一次性 shell**。持久终端由 `dsh-terminal-bash` 后端提供，本插件只替换一次性 `bash` 工具。

---

## 工程结构

```
src/index.ts      插件入口：apply / Config / agent 事件
src/config.ts     schemastery Config（全 volatile）+ 会话级快照
src/discover.ts   Git Bash 自动发现（含 WSL 排除）
src/paths.ts      路径算术：安装根、PATH 条目、校验、PATH 合成
src/executor.ts   GitBashExecutor（继承 LocalBashExecutor，含沙箱分支）
src/replace.ts    每会话替换 + 逆序回滚
src/diag.ts       诊断日志
src/types.ts      共享类型
src/shared/protocol.ts  Host/客户端共享的线路协议（路由路径、常量、视图类型）
src/routes.ts      两条只读 /api 路由：/state 与 /discover
src/client/        客户端半区：设置 → 通用 的「终端工具」行
                  index.ts 注册 settings.general.item；row.tsx 是行组件；
                  store.ts 是状态机（自动发现、写回、错误）；api.ts 取数
src/testing.ts     仅测试用的第二入口（不发布）
```

```powershell
npm run typecheck     # tsc --noEmit（devDeps 钉 0.2.1-rc.2 真 .d.ts）
npm run build         # esbuild → lib/index.js（Host ESM）+ lib/client.js（客户端半区，react 保持 external）
npm run contractcheck # Config 全 volatile / patch 行 / 导出面 / 客户端半区装载形状 / bundle 未内联第一方
npm run clientsmoke   # 真实执行 lib/client.js：模块装载形状、apply 注册行、无 configForms 时降级、迟到服务替换、HMR 幂等（8 项）
npm run rowselftest   # 行状态机 13 项：/state 读取、乐观写入、自动发现持久化、各类失败提示
npm run rend

plugins.description: A multi-agent group chat for DSH that decides who is worth waking: durable message log, attention routing, and cross-workspace membership.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-attention-group

**A multi-agent group chat for DSH that decides who is worth waking.**

A durable room for several DSH sessions — plus your own — where a message is written down
first, routed second, and only then allowed to wake anyone. An irrelevant message costs
**zero turns**.

---

## Why this is not another group chat

Every group chat spends its budget at delivery time: it wakes everyone, and each woken
member then discovers the message was not for them. That is N turns for one message nobody
needed.

This plugin moves the decision *before* the wake. Posting a message returns a routing plan

```
routing: SILENT — nobody matched, zero turns spent
```

or

```
routing: 1 recipient(s) — plan only, nothing woken
  room-admin	mention	not-woken (dry run)
```

Waking is a second, explicit step, and it needs **two** switches to agree (see
[Two switches](#waking-is-two-switches)).

Three consequences that are design rules here, not accidents:

- **Creating a room, adding members, reading history, exporting and summarising never wake anybody.**
- **A panel message that names nobody wakes nobody** — only NAMING somebody (`@name`, or `@所有人`
  while the room has 「允许 @所有人」 on) **and** the room's 「唤醒」 switch being on makes the panel
  wake those people. Beyond that, the only panel action that starts a turn is 「生成群史摘要」 (also
  gated on 「唤醒」 — see [Room-history summaries](#room-history-summaries-r9)). No name, no event:
  a person typing in their own panel is not a reason to run somebody else's session.
- **Nothing calls another plugin.** Rooms, transcripts, conclusions and exports are plain
  files, so this works on a bare DSH and survives this plugin being uninstalled.

---

## Quick start

### What you need

- DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** (this is the version every interface here was last verified against; it was
  first built against 0.2.0-rc.2, re-verified on 0.2.1-rc.1, and re-checked on 0.2.1-rc.2).
- A profile to install into. The examples below use `--profile desktop`.

### Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:cilarx/dsh-attention-group
```

That is the whole install. It was **verified end to end from a clean profile** on 2026-10-17:
the command exits 0, DSH initializes the profile, and the package lands with all seven
source files, its bundle patch and its `cordis.patch.yml`.

The bare-name form `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-attention-group` does **not** resolve
yet, because there is no npm release. Use the `github:` form above.

Any of a directory path, a tarball, or a git URL works, because `dsh plugin` **is** package
management: it delegates to `pnpm` in the profile directory (run `dsh plugin --profile <name>`
with no subcommand and pnpm's own help comes back). What makes the package a *plugin* is that
`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`.

A fresh profile gets **both halves** of the contract written for it automatically — the
dependency *and* the bundle layer — which is what makes the plugin actually load rather than
merely be installed:

```json
{ "dependencies": { "dsh-attention-group": "github:cilarx/dsh-attention-group" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "dsh-attention-group"] } } }
```

### Offline / from a checkout

Installing by path works too, and a packed tarball is verified end to end:

```bash
npm pack --pack-destination /tmp
dsh plugin --profile some-fresh-name add /tmp/dsh-attention-group-0.1.0.tgz
# → dsh: initialized profile some-fresh-name at ~/.dsh/profiles/some-fresh-name
```

Afterwards the new profile's `package.json` contained **both** halves of the contract on its
own — the dependency *and* the bundle layer:

```json
{ "dependencies": { "dsh-attention-group": "file:...tgz" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "dsh-attention-group"] } } }
```

and importing the installed copy from inside that profile succeeded, resolving
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` from the shared `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules`. So **a brand-new
profile can load this plugin** — that is what "works on a bare DSH" means here.

**A `link:` dependency and a directory junction both fail** (`unverified` for your machine,
measured here on 2026-10-16). Node resolves imports from a module's *real* path, so a linked
copy outside the profile resolves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` outside the profile too:

```
attention-group (dsh-attention-group): failed to import
ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'
```

Installing a real copy inside the profile is what fixes it.

### Verify the install registered

Two places in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` must name the package — a package
that is only in `dependencies` is installed but **is not a profile layer**, and nothing will
happen:

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-attention-group": "..." },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-attention-group" ] } }
}
```

### Restart DSH — this step is not optional

Host-side code (`src/index.js` and friends) is loaded once, at startup. Toggling the plugin
in the plugin panel does **not** re-import it; measured here, a newly added tool stayed
`unknown tool` across a toggle and appeared only after a restart. Install, then restart, then
look for the 「群聊」 entry in the sidebar.

### Development loop (source tree → live profile)

Because of the real-path rule above, editing this checkout edits nothing that DSH loads.
`tools/sync-plugin.ps1` copies the package into the profile and then *imports the copy* to
prove it still loads:

```powershell
pwsh -File tools/sync-plugin.ps1
```

### First 60 seconds

1. Sidebar → 「群聊」 → 「＋」 → name the room.
2. Settings → turn 「唤醒」 on only when you actually want group messages to be able to start
   turns.
3. Settings → add a member: **click the id box** and a list of this machine's sessions appears
   (title, workspace, last activity, most recent first) — click one and both the id and the
   `@` name are filled in. Pasting an id (`session-<uuid>` **or** a bare `<uuid>`) still works,
   and any stable id with kind `user` / `admin` / `bot` / `liaison` makes it a name in the room.
4. Ask the agent in that session to call `attention_group_list`, then `attention_send` with
   `wake` left off — you get the plan, and nobody is disturbed.

### Confirm the runtime is healthy

Call the `attention_probe` tool. It reports the data root, how many rooms exist, which live
agents are visible, which optional services this deployment offers, the last five wake-up
attempts with the path each one took, the status of the panel route (`registered`, or the
exact reason it is not), and whether the unread prompt line registered (`promptContext` — a
deployment with no prompt service loses that nudge, and this says so). A missing panel that
reads as "you have no rooms" is the failure this line exists to prevent.

---

## Core concepts

### Room

A room is a record in a JSON ledger plus one append-only JSONL transcript. It has an id
derived from its title (`插件工程协调-fpab`), a title, a charter, a member list, a routing
mode, one group-wide reasoning-effort knob, four sink settings, and a list of outgoing
liaisons.

### Member kinds

| kind | What it is | Can it be woken? |
|---|---|---|
| `session` | A DSH session, identified by its session id. | Yes — live or cold-resumed. |
| `user` | The human. The panel acts as this member. | No — recorded only. |
| `admin` | The room's built-in administrator. «总结今天»-style requests default to the first enabled `admin`. | No — recorded only, unless it is also a session id. |
| `bot` | Any non-session automated participant. | No — recorded only. |
| `liaison` | A reserved kind for an inter-room courier (see [Liaisons](#liaisons-r10)). | No — recorded only. |

**Both session-id shapes are real**: `session-<uuid>` and a bare `<uuid>`. Measured 2026-10-16
against the live runtime, `008bda70-4811-4349-a1a5-d6c6ff54d7d1` is a stored, resumable session
with a resolvable route — and most sessions on the machine this was developed on look like that.
An earlier version of this plugin required the `session-` prefix, which quietly made roughly
seventy real sessions unwakeable; the guard now accepts both.

Only ids that loo

plugins.description: Highlights sidebar session rows by state — pending approval, running, just finished — with color, animation and a matching status dot. | 按待审批、运行中、刚完成三种状态给侧边栏会话行上色、加呼吸动效，并在行尾配同色状态点。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pending-review-glow

给左侧会话列表的每一行加状态高亮，三种状态共用同一套「内描边 + 淡底」视觉语言，只用颜色和动效区分：

| 状态 | 颜色 | 动效 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pending` | 红 `rgba(244,63,94,…)` | 呼吸 1.5s | 有审批在等你 |
| `running` | 黄 `rgba(245,158,11,…)` | **常亮，不呼吸** | 推理/运行中 |
| `finished` | 绿 `rgba(34,197,94,…)` | 呼吸 1.5s | 刚跑完、不需要审核、且自那以后没点开过 |

优先级：红 > 黄 > 绿。行尾同时有一个同色小圆点（黄点常亮，红/绿点呼吸），作为槽位可见时更明确的提示。

- 包名 / 插件行 id：`dsh-pending-review-glow` / `pending-review-glow`
- 零依赖、零构建；浏览器半是 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory(require) })` 的 classic script
- 安装：插件页「添加插件」填本目录绝对路径（链接安装，改文件后重启即生效）

## 数据来源（全部是 emit 广播，无调用顺序问题）

| 状态 | 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| 待审核 | 会话审计事件 `approval/asked` / `approval/decided`（另用 `approval/request` + `prepend` 交叉校验） |
| 运行中 | `api-session/status(sessionId, running)` |
| 刚完成 | 同上，`running: true → false` 时记录时间戳 |

`approval/request` 监听器始终 `next()` 透传，不认领、不改写、不改超时任何审批。

## 路由

```
GET /pending-review-glow/state
{"revision":7,"seen":1,"asks":2,"count":1,
 "pending":[{"sessionId":"…","count":1,"tool":"…","since":…}],
 "running":["…"],
 "finished":[{"sessionId":"…","at":1760000000000}]}
```

- `asks`：累计 `approval/asked` 次数；`decided`：累计 `approval/decided` 次数；`seen`：`approval/request` 监听器执行次数；`count`：当前待审核会话数
- `recent`：最近 10 条与审批相关的事件类型（`approval/asked`、`approval/decided`、`turn/end`），排查"红色不灭"时看它
- 兜底：收到 `turn/end` 时强制清空该会话的 `asks` / `live` —— 审批是回合内封闭的，回合结束不可能还有未结审批
- 浏览器半按 `revision` 判重，`revision` 不变就不重渲染

## 绿色怎么消失

`finished` 只代表「跑完过」。浏览器半在两种情况下把 `sessionId → Date.now()` 写进 `localStorage`（键 `dsh-pending-review-glow:ack`），只要 `ack ≥ finished.at` 就不再绿，直到它下一次跑完刷新时间戳：

1. **该行被点击（pointerdown）** —— 你主动切过去看结果；
2. **跑完的那一刻该行正被选中** —— 你本来就开着它在看它跑完，算已看过。这条修复了"一直选中 → 跑完 → 切走 → 原行又变绿"的 bug。

另外为了让"你正打开的那个会话"不显示绿色，还会检查行元素上的高置信选中标记（`aria-selected="true"`、`aria-current="true|page"`、class 里的 `active|selected`）。**若这些标记都没命中**，当前会话跑完时也会短暂显示绿色，点它一次即可清除——这是已知的、可接受的近似。

## 渲染方式

浏览器半轮询路由（页面可见 400ms、切后台 3s，切回前台立刻补一次；请求不重叠），通过槽位 `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action`（每个会话行都会挂载）放探针组件：

- 探针沿 DOM 向上定位所在行（高 20–72px、宽 ≥100px），给行加 `data-dsh-session-state="pending|running|finished"`
- 样式由组件内联的 `<style>` 提供（卸载即失效），每 2s 重申一次属性防 React 冲掉
- `prefers-reduced-motion` 下红/绿呼吸自动降级为常亮描边

## 实测记录（2026-10-17）

| 检查 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 安装（插件页填本地目录） | 成功（链接到 `plugins/dsh-pending-review-glow`） |
| 无审批时 `/state` | `{revision:0,seen:0,asks:0,count:0,pending:[]}` |
| 审批悬置时 `/state` | `{revision:2,seen:1,asks:1,count:1,pending:[1]}` |
| 红色呼吸 + 行尾红点 | 用户确认生效 |
| 绿色呼吸 + 点击清除 | 用户确认生效 |

**踩过的坑（已修）**：三态改造时把 `running` 的会话 id 混进了 `pending` 列表，导致**运行中的行一律显示红色**。证据是那一刻的路由快照：`asks:0, decided:0, seen:0` 却 `count:1`，且 `pending` 那条记录的 `count` 是 0。现已把 `running` 从 `pending` 的 id 集合中移除，`running` 只出现在自己的字段里。


**已实测**：两条审批数据源、红色状态。
**待实测**（本轮新增）：黄色常亮（运行中）、绿色呼吸（跑完未点开）、点击后绿色消失、审批结算后红色熄灭。
**数据源风险**：`api-session/status` 若在某些装配下不广播，黄/绿不会出现——用下面的自检命令能立刻看出。

## 自检

```js
await (await fetch('/pending-review-glow/state')).json()
```

```js
document.querySelectorAll('[data-dsh-session-state]').length
```

## 卸载

插件页找到 `dsh-pending-review-glow` → 卸载 → 重启 DSH。清掉绿色记忆：Console 执行 `localStorage.removeItem('dsh-pending-review-glow:ack')`。

plugins.description: 让DSH在任何对话窗口都能记住你说过的关键信息
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-fuzzy-memory

给 DeepSeek Harness 的**模糊记忆**插件。作者：**YYY**（仓库：[yang02li/dsh-fuzzy-memory](https://github.com/yang02li/dsh-fuzzy-memory)）。

它不存全文，只存「关键词 + 一句话印象」；下一次撞上相关话题时，它可能想起来，也可能想不起来；时间久了会忘。这就是设计目标——像人，而不是数据库。

> 适配 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`（用到 `agent/pre-step`、`systemPrompt`、`tools` 接口）。DSH 大版本升级后请回归测试。

## 安装（从商城 / npm）

```bat
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-fuzzy-memory
```

或从 GitHub：

```bat
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yang02li/dsh-fuzzy-memory
```

装完重启 DSH，插件默认开启。开关与参数在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 id 覆盖。

## 它做什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 随机抽取 | 你每说一句话，有 `sampleRate`（默认 35%）的概率被抽一个关键词，配一句话印象存到本地 |
| 核心档案 | 「我叫阳阳 / 我喜欢喝乌龙茶 / 我住杭州」这类显式事实单独存成 `profile`，**每段会话开头强制带上**，不靠关键词碰运气 |
| 显式记忆 | 句子里出现「记住 / 我喜欢 / 我叫 / 生日 / 下次」等触发词时，无条件记一条 |
| 模型主动记 | 提供 `fuzzy_remember` 工具，模型觉得值得记时自己调 |
| 按需想起 | 每轮对话前，用你这句话给所有记忆打分，命中一条就在对话里注入「你模糊记得：……」。分数低于阈值就什么都不注入——那就是「想不起来」 |
| 会遗忘 | 30 天没被想起，置信度打八折；低于阈值从检索里消失；库超过上限时按「可信度 × 新鲜度」淘汰 |
| 主动回忆 | 提供 `fuzzy_recall` 工具，模型想不起某事时可以翻记忆库 |
| 可选人设 | 在配置里填 `persona` 会追加到系统提示词；打开 `personaComplete` 会替换整个系统提示词（陪伴模式） |

关闭开关时，插件不注册任何东西，就是原生 DeepSeek。

## 本地开发 / 从源码安装

1. 双击 `install.cmd`。它做三件事：自检记忆内核、拷插件到 profile、用 node 真 import 一次验证；任何一步失败都会自动回滚。
2. 装完关闭 DSH 的黑色窗口，重新双击启动器。
3. 新开会话，说一句「记住我叫阳阳」，再新开一个会话问「我叫啥」。

插件默认就是开着的。想回到原生模式，编辑 `data\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml` 加一段覆盖，重启：

```yaml
- id: dsh-fuzzy-memory
  config:
    enabled: false
```

如果双击被系统拦住（编码/权限问题很常见），直接在 PowerShell 里粘这一行：

```powershell
& "D:\DeepSeek-Harness-Portable-0.2.0-rc.2\node.exe" "C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\dsh-fuzzy-memory\tools\install.mjs" "D:\DeepSeek-Harness-Portable-0.2.0-rc.2"
```

## 打包 / 发布

```bat
pack.cmd
```

产物在 `dist\dsh-fuzzy-memory-0.2.0.tgz`。发布到插件商城的完整步骤见 [PUBLISHING.md](./PUBLISHING.md)。


## 配置

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | true | 总开关，关闭时插件不生效 |
| `persona` | 空 | 基础人设文本 |
| `personaComplete` | false | true = 人设替换整个系统提示词；不要和自带 `complete` 人设的预设同时开 |
| `sampleRate` | 0.35 | 随机记忆采样率，0 = 只记显式触发 |
| `threshold` | 0.5 | 检索阈值，越高越不容易想起来 |
| `maxEntries` | 300 | 记忆库上限 |
| `cooldownTurns` | 2 | 同一条记忆至少隔几回合再出现 |
| `enableTools` | true | 是否注册 `fuzzy_remember` / `fuzzy_recall`；关掉省约 240 token/轮，自动记忆和注入照常 |

配置改动需要重启 DSH 才生效（插件只在启动时挂载）。

## 成本

| 项 | 量级 | 频率 |
|---|---|---|
| 两个工具 schema | ~240 token | 每轮（`enableTools: false` 可去掉） |
| 核心档案卡 | ~25 token | 每段会话一次，之后随历史重发 |
| 命中记忆卡 | ~30 token | 命中时一次，之后随历史重发 |
| 额外模型调用 | 0 | 抽取、检索、衰减全在本地 |

关工具的方式（profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-fuzzy-memory
  config:
    enableTools: false
```


## 记忆存在哪

```
<DSH_HOME>\fuzzy-memory\memories.jsonl
```

每行一条：

```json
{"id":"...","kw":["三体"],"gist":"黑暗森林那段还是很震撼","kind":"impression","conf":0.55,"t":1792...,"hits":1}
```

纯本地文件，可以直接看、直接改、直接删。

## 原理

1. **抽取**：中文没有分词器，用 2~4 字窗口 + 停用字过滤 + 取最长不重叠，抽到「三体」「黑暗森林」这类词；抽不到像样的就跳过。
2. **打分**：
   ```
   0.6 × 关键词重合 + 0.2 × 新鲜度 + 0.1 × 置信度 + 0.1 × 随机抖动
   ```
   抖动是故意的：同一句话，有时想得起，有时想不起。
3. **注入**：命中时在用户消息后追加一条 `user` 快照消息（不改系统提示词前缀，不破坏缓存），内容约 30 字。
4. **衰减**：只读计算，不反复改写文件；`conf × 0.8^(天数/30)`。

## 工具

- `fuzzy_remember(keywords, gist, kind?, confidence?)` — 主动记一条
- `fuzzy_recall(query)` — 主动检索，返回最像的 3 条

## 卸载

双击 `uninstall.cmd`，重启 DSH。记忆文件保留，想清空就删 `<DSH_HOME>\fuzzy-memory\`。

## 已知限制

- 中文关键词是启发式抽取，质量不如模型判断；重要的事让它调 `fuzzy_remember`。
- 注入的记忆是持久消息，会占一点上下文（约 30 token/次），只在命中时发生。
- 插件目前是 host 侧，没有独立 UI；开关和参数在「设置 → 插件」的表单里。
- 配置改动需要重启；未做热重载。

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. Relay and local network are two different setups, not two settings of one, so pick the one that matches wha

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: Per-project CodeGraph MCP tools for DeepSeek Harness: each session queries the repo it is actually working in
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codegraph-project **让 DeepSeek Harness 的每个会话，只查它自己所在仓库的 CodeGraph 索引。** [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-5ad1c4)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![CodeGraph](https://img.shields.io/badge/CodeGraph-1.6.2%20verified-f0a75a)](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-27%20passing-6bc46d)](#验证) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](#license)
--- **这是一个 CodeGraph 兼容层，不是又一个 CodeGraph。** 插件不重新实现任何索引、查询或代码分析逻辑——它直接复用你已经安装的 CodeGraph CLI 和它建好的 `.codegraph/` 索引，把工具按**项目维度**接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)。因此： - CodeGraph 升级、换版本、重建索引，本插件照常工作； - Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的 CodeGraph 配置**原样保留**，互不影响——本插件不写任何全局配置文件，不抢注任何 MCP 服务名； - 卸载本插件，你的 CodeGraph 环境和你其他工具的集成完全不受影响。 接入后，DSH 里的每个会话根据自己的工作目录自动定位 `.codegraph/` 索引，多项目各用各的连接，互不串味。 ## 传统接法的问题：一个 cwd，多个仓库 把 CodeGraph 接进任何宿主（包括 DSH），官方姿势都是配一个 MCP 服务、指向一个项目目录。这在单仓库下没有问题，但 DSH 的插件配置是 **profile 级（全局）**——你只有一个配置位，却可能同时开着五六个仓库的会话： ```yaml - insert: - id: mcp-codegraph name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client" config: cwd: D:\path\to\only-one-project # ← 换个项目就错了 ``` 后果不是报错，而是更糟的**静默查错仓库**——你在仓库 B 的会话里提问，它返回仓库 A 的结果。会话看起来一切正常，答案却是另一个代码库的，直到某天你发现它引用了一个根本不存在的类。 本插件解决的问题就一句话：**让"当前项目"由会话自己决定，而不是由一份全局配置决定。** ## 解法：把"项目"补在 DSH 侧 ``` agent A（仓库甲的会话）── mcp__codegraph__codegraph_explore ──→ ProjectHub(甲) ──→ codegraph 进程 #1 agent B（仓库甲的会话）── mcp__codegraph__codegraph_explore ──→ （共享 #1） agent C（仓库乙的会话）── mcp__codegraph__codegraph_explore ──→ ProjectHub(乙) ──→ codegraph 进程 #2 agent D（无索引目录） ──（看不到任何 codegraph 工具） ``` 三条核心机制： 1. **工具注册在会话 scope 上** —— `agent.ctx.tools.register()`。无索引的会话根本看不到工具，不需要运行时拒绝。 2. **每个项目一个子进程** —— 进程 `cwd` 就是项目根，查询不需要额外参数；同项目的多个会话共享一个进程（引用计数，归零才关）。 3. **子进程走 `ctx.subprocess`** —— 由 DSH 托管，插件停用或 harness 退出时进程一定被回收。 挂载由一个会话级 `agent/pre-step` 监听器持续对齐，因此同时覆盖：会话中途 `codegraph init`（下一条消息即可用）、中途 `cd` 到另一个仓库（工具跟随切换）、索引被删除（工具消失）。 ## 安装 **前置条件** - DeepSeek Harness（`0.2.1-rc.2` 已验证） - [CodeGraph CLI](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph) 已全局安装（`codegraph` 在 PATH 上，或配置 `codegraphBin`） - 目标项目执行过 `codegraph init` **两种安装方式** ```bash # 方式一：从 npm 安装（推荐，装完即用） dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-codegraph-project # 方式二：本地目录（开发/自用） # 在 DSH 的 Plugins 页粘贴本仓库的绝对路径，或用 CLI： dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add <本仓库路径> ``` > **两种方式的差异**：从 npm 安装时，依赖（`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`）随包自动 > 就位，无需任何额外步骤；本地目录安装时，由于 ESM 从源码目录解析依赖，需要先在 > 仓库里执行一次 `npm install --omit=dev`。 包已发布：[npmjs.com/package/dsh-codegraph-project](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-codegraph-project) · 当前版本见 `npm view dsh-codegraph-project version`。 安装后**零配置**：有索引的会话自动获得工具，没有的会话干净如初。 ## 配置 所有配置都有默认值，通常不需要动。在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖： ```yaml - id: codegraph-project config: serverName: codegraph # 工具命名空间 toolCallTimeoutMs: 60000 # 单次调用超时 watchIntervalMs: 2000 # 无索引会话的重探间隔 ``` | 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；`false` 时不注册工具、不起进程 | | `serverName` | `codegraph` | 公开工具名为 `mcp____` | | `codegraphBin` | `''` | 可执行文件绝对路径；留空从 PATH 探测 | | `codegraphArgs` | `['serve', '--mcp']` | 配合 `codegraphBin` 的参数 | | `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 单次工具调用超时（必须为正数） | | `connectTimeoutMs` | `5000` | MCP 握手超时 | | `watchIntervalMs` | `2000` | 无索引会话的重新探测间隔，`0` 表示每条消息都探测 | **Windows 的 `.cmd` 坑**：npm 全局安装的 `codegraph` 是 `.cmd` 批处理，不能直接 spawn。插件会自动从 npm 全局布局推导 `node.exe` + 入口脚本；推导失败时错误信息里 给出可直接粘贴的 `codegraphBin` / `codegraphArgs` 配置。 ## 认领规则：什么时候一个目录算"项目" 会话目录向上逐层查找 `.codegraph/`，四条边界规则防止"静默服务错误仓库"： | 规则 | 原因 | |---|---| | `.codegraph/` 里必须有 `*.db` | 只有 `daemon.pid` / `daemon.log` 的目录不是项目 | | 遇到 `.git` 就停 | 索引在仓库边界之上属于别的仓库 | | 家目录 / 文件系统根不算 | 否则 `~/.codegraph/` 会让 `$HOME` 下所有会话认领它 | | `.codegraph` 读不了就停 | 继续向上会把权限问题变成查错仓库 | ## 验证 ```bash npm install --omit=dev # 先装依赖（见上） node --test test/locate.test.js test/pool.test.js test/bridge.test.js # 27 个单元测试 node scripts/check-locate.mjs # 认领规则 + 真机抽查 node scripts/check-sharing.mjs <有索引的项目目录> # 同项目共享一个进程 node scripts/check-failure-reporting.mjs # 启动失败的去重上报 node scripts/probe.mjs <有索引的项目目录> <查询词> # 真实 CodeGraph 端到端 node scripts/acceptance.mjs # 真机验收（headless） ``` 部分脚本接受环境变量指定本机测试项目： | 变量 | 用于 | 默认 | |---|---|---| | `CODEGRAPH_TEST_PROJECT` | `check-sharing.mjs`、`acceptance.mjs` | `.` | | `CODEGRAPH_TEST_PROJECTS` | `check-locate.mjs`（逗号分隔多个） | 跳过真机抽查 | | `DSH_BIN` | `acceptance.mjs`（dsh CLI 路径） | Windows 默认安装位置 | `acceptance.mjs` 会临时把插件与探针装进 `headless` profile、跑完自动还原；它验证 Host 内部可观察状态（会话可见工具、进程事实），不跑模型轮次。 ## 诊断 DSH 的 `SubprocessHandle` 不暴露 pid，插件改用**项目标识**对应进程与日志： - 每个 codegraph 子进程带环境变量 `DSH_CODEGRAPH_PROJECT=<项目根>`，按环境变量反查进程即可； - `ProjectHub.projectTag` / `ProjectHub.stderrTail` 暴露同一标识与子进程 stderr 尾部； - 会话销毁时按 debug 级记录释放结果与剩余会话数； - 启动失败在同一项目上只告警一次，恢复后复发会再次告警。 ## 更新 已通过 npm 安装后，升级到新版本： ```bash dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-codegraph-project # 重新 add 即升级到 latest ``` 维护者发布新版本： ```bash # 改代码 → 测试 → 提交（npm version 要求工作区干净） npm test git add -A && git commit -m "..." # 升版本号（同时改 package.json + 自动 commit + 打 tag） npm version patch # 修 bug：0.1.0 → 0.1.1 npm version minor # 新功能：0.1.0 → 0.2.0 npm version major # 破坏性变更：0.1.0 → 1.0.0 git push && git push --tags npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org ``` 版本号遵循 [semver](https://semver.org/lang/zh-CN/)：已发布的版本号永不复用，改动再小也发新版本号。 ## 文档 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | [docs/implementation-plan.md](docs/implementation-plan.md) | 开发指南：架构、逐模块实现、实施顺序、验收清单 | | [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) | 7 个关键设计决策与被否决的替代方案 | | [docs/technical-findings.md](docs/technical-findings.md) | 12 项 DSH 源码调研与运行时验证记录 | | [docs/risks.md](docs/risks.md) | 13 项风险与边界条件 | | [docs/why-no-prompt.md](docs/why-no-prompt.md) | 为什么不注入提示词 | ## 与 troytse/dsh-plugin-codegraph-project 的差异 参考过 [troytse/dsh-plugin-codegraph-project](https://github.com/troytse/dsh-plugin-codegraph-project)（MIT），设计取舍不同： | 能力 | 它 | 本插件 | |---|---|---| | CodeGraph 来源 | npx 拉取 + 版本管理 | 用系统已安装的 | | 工具注册 | 全局 + guard + 路由 | 按会话 scope | | 索引发现 | 250 行轮询 | `agent/pre-step` 懒检测 | | 提示词 | 注入 usage guidance | 不注入 | | 规模 | ~2900 行 | ~960 行 | ## License MIT

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /

plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a
