plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: DSH 桌面通知：所有前端失焦时把决策 / 授权 / 中断 / 完成发到 Windows 通知中心；点击复用已有页面切回对话。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desktop-notify

> 所有 DSH 前端都失焦时，把「需要你决策 / 需要你授权 / 意外中断 / 任务完成」发到 Windows 通知中心；通知标题是会话标题，点击通知复用已打开的 DSH 页面切回对应对话。

![Windows 通知截图](docs/notification.png)

![自绘通知卡片](docs/card.png)

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @carbonzhao/dsh-desktop-notify
```

重启 `dsh web`，然后硬刷新页面（Ctrl+Shift+R）。也可以从源码安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:CarbonZhao-02692/dsh-desktop-notify`。

## 能力分类

界面与体验。

## 它能做什么

| 事件 | 触发点 | 通知内容 |
|---|---|---|
| 需要你选择决策 | `user-questions/request`（含方案确认 plan-review） | `需要你选择决策：<问题>` |
| 需要你授权 | `approval/request` | `需要你授权：<工具名> — <原因>` |
| 意外中断，请重试 | `turn/end` reason=`error` / `interrupted` / `max-tokens`，以及 `api-session/error` | `任务意外中断：<错误>，请重试` |
| 任务已完成 | `turn/end` reason=`completed` | `任务已完成（用时 X）` |

通知标题取自**对应会话的标题**（`sessionTitle` 服务折叠出的标题）；标题还没生成时回退到该会话第一条用户消息。通知正文是对应提示。

## 焦点判定：所有 DSH 前端都失焦

每个 DSH 页面每 3 秒向 `/dsh-desktop-notify/focus` 上报：

```json
{ "id": "页面 id", "focused": true, "visible": true }
```

`focused = document.visibilityState === 'visible' && document.hasFocus()`。浏览器窗口失焦、切到其他标签页、焦点在地址栏，都会使 `focused` 为 false。

host 的门控只有一条：

- **任意一个页面 `focused=true` → 不是“所有前端失焦”，静默不发。**
- **所有已上报页面 `focused=false` → 发通知。**
- 页面关闭时通过 `sendBeacon` 上报 `closed: true`，立即从汇总移除。
- 后台标签页的定时器可能被浏览器节流，所以 3 分钟内没有心跳才按已关闭处理；所有页面都关闭时视为“全部失焦”。

`visible` 只用于状态展示，不参与门控。

## 通知模式与点击回到对话

配置项 `enableCard` 决定通知形态：

### `enableCard: false`（默认）

只显示正常的 Windows toast，不显示自绘卡片：

1. toast 带 `activationType="protocol"` 和 `launch="dsh-desktop-notify://open?session=<id>&origin=<origin>"`；Windows 调用协议 helper `assets/open.ps1`。
2. 同时启动 `assets/toast-listener.ps1`，在隐藏 PowerShell 进程里保持 `ToastNotification` 存活；如果 `Activated` 事件被投递，也会调用同一个 helper。
3. helper 把会话 id POST 到 host 的 `/dsh-desktop-notify/activate`，用 `ShowWindow` / `SetForegroundWindow` 恢复并置前 Edge/Chrome 窗口（只有最小化时才 `SW_RESTORE`，最大化保持不变）。
4. helper 通过 UI Automation 把标题匹配的 DSH 标签页切到前台；已打开的 DSH 页面每秒轮询 `/dsh-desktop-notify/activation`，收到后调用 `uiWorkspace.openSession(sessionId)`。
5. host 只把请求投递给**用户最后使用的那个页面**，多标签不会一起跳。

### `enableCard: true`

只显示右下角原生 WPF 卡片，不发送任何 Windows toast：

1. host 启动 `assets/notify-card.ps1`，显示应用名、鲸鱼图标、会话标题和正文，不抢焦点，20 秒后自动关闭。
2. 点击卡片调用 `assets/open.ps1`，后续的激活、窗口恢复、标签页切换与上面相同。
3. 不使用浏览器通知；通知中心不会留下记录。

**没有页面时的兜底**：如果 host 发现没有任何已连接的 DSH 页面，会让 helper 在默认浏览器打开一个引导页；引导页把会话 id 写入 `localStorage` 并跳回 DSH，新页面加载后自动打开对应对话。

## 设置页与测试

DSH 设置 → 通用 → **桌面通知**：

- 显示当前上报页面数和焦点汇总状态（有前端聚焦 = 静默中 / 全部失焦 = 会通知）。
- “自绘卡片”开关：切换 `enableCard`，立即生效并持久化到 `%DSH_HOME%\super-injector\dsh-desktop-notify-config.json`；关闭则只发 Windows toast，打开则只显示可点击卡片。
- “发送测试通知”按钮：强制发一条通知，忽略焦点门控，用来验证当前模式、应用名、图标与点击行为。

也可以直接调用 HTTP 接口：

```powershell
# 查看焦点状态与最近通知
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-desktop-notify/status

# 强制发一条测试通知（force 忽略焦点门控；带 sessionId 时点击会回到该对话）
$body = @{ kind='complete'; force=$true; sessionId='session-...'; body='测试通知' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' `
  -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)) `
  http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-desktop-notify/test
```

## 配置

默认值在 `lib/index.js` 的 `DEFAULTS` 里；通过 loader 行的 `config` 覆盖：

```yaml
- id: dsh-desktop-notify
  name: '@carbonzhao/dsh-desktop-notify'
  config:
    onlyWhenUnfocused: true   # false = 页面聚焦时也发
    clickToOpen: true         # false = 通知不可点击回会话
    enableCard: false         # true = 仅自绘卡片；false = 仅普通 Windows toast
    ignoreSubagent: true      # 后台子代理会话不提醒
    notifyOnDecision: true
    notifyOnApproval: true
    notifyOnInterruption: true
    notifyOnComplete: true
    minTurnDurationMs: 0      # 完成提醒的最短轮次时长（毫秒）
    toastAppId: 'DeepSeek.DSH.Notify'
    toastAppName: 'Deepseek Harness Notification'
    toastIconPath: ''         # 默认 assets/deepseek-harness.png
    toastAppIconPath: ''      # 默认 assets/deepseek-harness.ico
```

## 兼容与运行要求

- DSH `web` profile；实测 `0.2.1-rc.2`（当前 checkout）。
- Windows 10 / 11，Windows PowerShell 5.1（WinRT toast）。
- Node.js >= 20。
- 页面必须保持打开才能上报焦点；没有页面时点击通知会走兜底新开页。
- 浏览器 / DSH Desktop 需要允许 Windows 通知；系统“专注助手”可能拦截。
- 仅实现 Windows toast；其他平台只写日志、不发通知。

## 权限与外部服务

- 写入 `HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-desktop-notify`（自定义协议 helper）。
- 写入 `HKCU\Software\Classes\AppUserModelId\DeepSeek.DSH.Notify`（应用名与图标）。
- toast 模式会注册 `HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-desktop-notify` 协议；卡片模式不发送 toast，也不注册协议。
- 通过 `powershell.exe` 显示 toast 或卡片，并在临时目录写一个 `.ps1` 脚本。
- helper 使用 Windows UI Automation 查找并切换浏览器标签页（不需要管理员权限）。
- 本机 HTTP 路由：`/focus`、`/status`、`/test`、`/activate`、`/activation`、`/open`；其中 `/activate` 和 `/open` 只接受 loopback 请求，`/open` 还需要每次进程随机生成的密钥。
- 没有外部服务、没有上传、没有网络请求（除本机 DSH 地址）。

## 真实输出

### toast 模式（`enableCard: false`）

```xml
<toast activationType="protocol" launch="dsh-desktop-notify://open?session=session-...&origin=http%3A%2F%2F127.0.0.1%3A3080">
  <visual><binding template="ToastGeneric">
    <text>示例会话标题</text>
    <text>点击通知应回到对应对话</text>
    <image placement="appLogoOverride" src="file:///.../assets/deepseek-harness.png"/>
  </binding></visual>
  <audio src="ms-winsoundevent:Notification.Default"/>
</toast>
```

### 卡片模式（`enableCard: true`）

```text
shown
clicked
start uri=dsh-desktop-notify://open?session=session-...
activate hwnd=... minimized=False maximized=True foreground=True
tab selected: 示例会话标题 — DeepSeek Harness ...
activation queued session=session-... target=dsh-... live=1
activation delivered session=session-... client=dsh-...
```

## 已知限制

- 后台子代理会话默认不提醒（它们的完成由主对话那一轮覆盖）。
- `enableCard: false` 时通知中心里的 toast 点击是否触发协议/Activated 取决于 Windows 环境；当前这台 Windows 10 上两者都未触发。
- `enableCard: true` 时可点击的是右下角原生卡片；卡片 20 秒后自动关闭。
- 窗口恢复/置前对 Edge/Chrome 使用 Win32 `ShowWindow` + `SetForegroundWindow`；只有最小化时才 `SW_RESTORE`，最大化窗口保持最大化。系统前台锁定、虚拟桌面切换等极端情况仍可能失败。
- 标签页切换 / 窗口激活目前针对 Edge / Chrome；DSH 在 Firefox 中时不会自动切回该标签页。
- 标签页切换按标题匹配；多个标签页标题相同时，可能选中同标题的另一个 DSH 标签页（仍会落在对应会话）。
- helper 日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notify-helper.log`；卡片日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notify-card.log`；toast listener 日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notify-toast.log`。
- Windows 可能缓存 AUMID 的应用名/图标；重启 Explorer 或清空通知历史后会刷新。

## 开发

插件是纯 ESM/CJS JavaScript，无构建步骤、无第三方运行时依赖。

- host：[lib/index.js](lib/index.js)
- client：[lib/client.js](lib/client.js)
- 协议 helper：[assets/open.ps1](assets/open.ps1)
- toast listener：[assets/toast-listener.ps1](assets/toast-listener.ps1)
- 原生通知卡片：[assets/notify-card.ps1](assets/notify-card.ps1)
- 图标：[assets/deepseek-harness.png](assets/deepseek-harness.png)、[assets/deepseek-harness.ico](assets/deepseek-harness.ico)
- 条目：[cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml)

本地修改后重新加载插件或重启 DSH。

## License

MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

图标来自官方 DSH 前端资源（MIT）；DeepSeek Harness 与鲸鱼标识归各自所有者，本插件非官方出品。见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

plugins.description: Draws mermaid code blocks in DSH replies as diagrams, including while the reply is still streaming.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-mermaid Draws ```` ```mermaid ```` code blocks in DSH replies as diagrams — **including while the reply is still streaming**.

> dsh-plugin-mermaid — 把回复里的 ```mermaid 代码块画成图表，边流式输出边画
中文说明（点开） —— 不用等一轮回复结束才看到图 **它是什么**：模型在回复里写 ```` ```mermaid ```` 围栏，你看到的是图，不是代码。图上方一条细栏写着 `Mermaid`，右边是 **复制** 和 **源码/图表** 开关。 **为什么不是"等回复结束再画"**：DSH 渲染流式回复时，**已完成的块只解析一次、React 元素被缓存**，每个 token 只重建尾部那一块。所以规则只有一条：**源文本静止 220ms 才画**。token 在流 → 计时器一直被重置 → 什么都不画；围栏一闭、后面的正文开始到达 → 块冻结 → 图立刻出现。模型在围栏里停顿时不会画出半张图。 **复制**：图模式复制一张 PNG（2–3 倍尺寸、铺了代码块自己的底色，粘到文档里就是一张图）；源码模式复制 Mermaid 文本。浏览器剪贴板不收 SVG，所以图是先栅格化再写的 —— 这也是 Mermaid 跑在 `htmlLabels: false` 的原因：`` 里的 HTML 在"SVG 当图片"时会消失。 **认不出来就不画**：Mermaid 解析失败的块原样保留，不插任何东西。 **装法**：Plugin Manager 的 Add plugin 填 `github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-mermaid#v0.2.1`，或指向本地目录。装完**重启 app**（Host 半边开机才加载资产路由），页面再 **⌘R**。 **它没有做什么**：不改 Markdown 渲染器、不占槽位、不加工具。只在代码块的 `data-code-block-content` 里加一个节点，用一条 `:has()` 规则把源码 `
` 藏起来。
## What it does The model writes a fenced block: ````text ```mermaid flowchart LR A["工作区"] --> B["暂存区"] --> C["仓库"] ``` ```` You see the diagram, under a small bar that names it and offers **源码** (source) and copy. The block's own "Code block" banner is hidden while the diagram is shown, because the plugin never touches the `
` React owns — it
adds a sibling and hides the original with CSS.

**Copy follows the view.** With the diagram on screen the button puts a PNG on
the clipboard (2–3× the drawn size, on the block's own surface colour, so it
pastes into a document without a transparent-background surprise); with the
source on screen it copies the Mermaid text. Browser clipboards will not take an
SVG reliably, so the diagram is drawn through a canvas first — which is also why
Mermaid runs with `htmlLabels: false`: `foreignObject` HTML does not survive that
trip.

## Why this is not a Markdown plugin

There is no slot between "Markdown" and "code block". The only seat a plugin can
take is the whole `assistant-step` node, and taking it would mean re-implementing
Markdown — file links, image lightboxes, KaTeX, syntax highlighting, copy
buttons, sticky banners — to add one block type.

So the plugin decorates the primitive's own markup instead:

```
div.md-code-block
  div.bannerWrap                   ← hidden while a diagram is shown
    div[data-code-block-banner]    ← language label + copy
  div[data-code-block-content]
    pre                            ← the source (left in place, hidden by CSS)
    div.dsh-mermaid                ← the one node the plugin adds
```

The coupling is that markup. `tests/dom.test.mjs` drives a stand-in with the same
shape in a real browser, so a change to it fails loudly here instead of silently
drawing nothing.

## Why streaming needs care

DSH renders a live reply with an incremental Markdown renderer: every completed
block is parsed once and its React elements are cached, so only the growing tail
is re-rendered on each token. That gives one precise rule:

> never draw the tail; draw only a source that has stopped changing.

A block is drawn after its source has been unchanged for 220 ms. While tokens
flow the timer keeps resetting; when the fence closes and the next prose starts,
the block freezes, and the diagram appears mid-reply — no waiting for the turn to
end. A pause *inside* an open fence that lasts longer than 220 ms will draw
whatever has arrived; if the source then keeps growing, the panel is dropped and
redrawn, and a source Mermaid rejects leaves the code block exactly as it was.

Rendered diagrams are cached by source + theme, so a re-render (React rebuilding
the message, a theme switch) costs no Mermaid work.

## Where Mermaid comes from

The browser half asks the Host for `/api/mermaid.asset.js`; the Host serves the
`mermaid.min.js` from this package's own dependency tree over the same
authenticated, same-origin channel as the rest of the Web UI. The build is found
by Node's own resolution (`createRequire`), not by a fixed
`./node_modules/…` path: pnpm — which the Plugin Manager uses — keeps a
package's dependencies *beside* it, so a fixed path would 404 on every install
from Git while working perfectly in a linked checkout. It is a 3.4 MB
script, so it is fetched the first time a diagram is seen, not on every page
load, and revalidated with an ETag.

## Limits

- Diagrams are rendered in the browser only. A DSH client without the plugin (a
  phone on an old tab, `--no-client` tooling) shows the code block.
- Mermaid's `strict` security level is used: HTML labels are sanitized, and
  click-to-activate links are not available.
- A diagram Mermaid rejects is not decorated at all. The reason is logged to the
  browser console (`[mermaid] …`); there is no inline error row, because during
  streaming an incomplete diagram would flash one.
- No per-block history: the panel is a view of the file's Markdown, not a record.

## Install

Use DSH's own **Add plugin** dialog. No npm account, no publishing.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| GitHub | `github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-mermaid#v0.2.1` |
| Local directory | an absolute path, e.g. `/path/to/dsh-plugin-mermaid` |

Restart the desktop app afterwards: the Host half owns the asset route and is
only loaded at startup. The browser half reloads with the page (`⌘R`).

This plugin is **not published to npm**, and `npm install` is not the install
path. Its one runtime dependency (the Mermaid build the Host serves) is installed
from the repository's `package.json`.

## Tests

```bash
npm ci
npm test           # 18: classifier, loader contract, patch/manifest consistency, the Host route, module resolution
npm run test:dom   # 33 in headless Chrome over CDP: `:has()`, real Mermaid output, the streaming sequence, both clipboard flavours
```

`test:dom` skips when no Chrome or Chromium is installed.

## Licence

MIT.

plugins.description: Codex-style file-based long-term memory for DSH: two-stage extraction, consolidated MEMORY.md handbook, prompt-injected summary, and search/read/list/note tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-memories

Codex-style **long-term memory** for DSH: cross-session memory that ingests finished sessions, consolidates them into a searchable handbook, and injects a compact summary before every turn.

It reproduces the two-stage structure of the Codex memory system rather than approximating it: per-session extraction first, then a consolidation pass over many raw memories.

## Why

DSH sessions are isolated by default. A correction you made yesterday, a command that only works in one repo, a symptom/cause/fix you already paid for — none of it carries over unless you restate it. This plugin makes the agent remember:

- how you want it to work, without being told twice
- where the truth lives in a specific repo, and which commands actually run
- which failure has which fix

## How it works

```
session goes idle for N seconds
   └─ Stage 1  one model call per session -> session_summaries/<slug>.md + raw_memories.md
        └─ Stage 2  once enough memory accumulates -> MEMORY.md + memory_summary.md
             └─ before each turn, memory_summary.md is injected into the prompt
```

All durable artifacts are plain Markdown you can read, edit, version, or move. `index.json` holds the extraction cache, job records, and the consolidation watermark.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @lushdawn/dsh-codex-memories
```

Local development:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<absolute path to this directory>
```

Restart DSH, or let a live profile hot-load it.

## Commands

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `/memory status` | memory root, extracted sessions, pending consolidation, last timestamps |
| `/memory show` | print the current `memory_summary.md` |
| `/memory extract` | extract the current session immediately |
| `/memory backfill` | scan stored sessions and extract the ones never processed |
| `/memory consolidate` | merge pending memory into `MEMORY.md` now |
| `/memory forget <sessionId\|all>` | drop extraction records (handbook content is kept) |
| `/memory on` / `off` | toggle automatic extraction for this process |

## Tools

Exposed to the model when `dedicatedTools` is on:

| Tool | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_search` | line-level keyword search across memory files (`any` / `all` / `on_same_line`) |
| `memory_read` | read one memory file by line range |
| `memory_list` | inventory of the memory folder and pending work |
| `memory_note` | append one ad-hoc note — the only write path the model is offered |

The model is instructed to cite memory as `MEMORY.md:12-14|note=[...]`.

## Configuration

Every field has a safe default; override in your profile patch:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-codex-memories
      name: dsh-codex-memories
      config:
        storageDir: ''            # default $DSH_HOME/memories
        generate: true
        use: true
        dedicatedTools: true
        model: ''                 # e.g. deepseek-official/deepseek-flash
        extractModel: ''          # falls back to model
        consolidationModel: ''    # falls back to model
        idleSeconds: 120
        maxSessionsPerRun: 3
        maxSessionAgeDays: 30
        consolidationThreshold: 2
        maxInjectChars: 9000
        minSessionMessages: 4
        extractMaxTokens: 8000
        consolidateMaxTokens: 16000
```

When `model` is empty the plugin reads the current default model, then falls back to `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`.

## Data layout

```
$DSH_HOME/memories/
├── MEMORY.md                    # durable handbook, Task Group organized
├── memory_summary.md            # prompt-loaded layer; first line must be v1
├── raw_memories.md              # mechanical stage-1 merge, ascending session id
├── session_summaries/<slug>.md  # one structured recap per session
├── extensions/ad_hoc/notes/     # notes written by you or the model
└── index.json                   # extraction cache, job records, watermark
```

## Cost and privacy

- **It spends tokens**: one Stage-1 call per session and one Stage-2 call per consolidation. Sessions under 4 messages are skipped; at most 3 sessions are processed per sweep.
- **Local files only**: no network access beyond the model API it calls.
- **It enters your prompt**: `memory_summary.md` is injected every turn, which is why it is capped by `maxInjectChars`.
- **Auditable**: every artifact is readable Markdown.
- **The model cannot rewrite the handbook**: it may only append ad-hoc notes; consolidation is a separate pass, so one turn cannot corrupt durable memory.

## Fidelity to Codex

The behavioral spec comes from reverse engineering Codex itself — the on-disk shape under `~/.codex/memories` plus the prompt templates embedded in `codex.exe`:

| Codex | dsh-codex-memories |
| --- | --- |
| `~/.codex/memories/` | `$DSH_HOME/memories/` |
| `MEMORY.md` / `memory_summary.md` / `raw_memories.md` | same names, same formats |
| `rollout_summaries/*.md` | `session_summaries/*.md` |
| `memories_1.sqlite` | `index.json` |
| Stage 1 extraction prompt | `PHASE1_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| Phase 2 consolidation prompt | `PHASE2_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| usage guidance + citation format | `USAGE_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| rollout scan backfill | `/memory backfill` + boot sweep |

See [docs/mechanism.md](docs/mechanism.md) for the full mechanism and the evidence behind it.

## Known limits

- Stage 2 asks for two complete documents in one reply. On a very large handbook the reply can hit the output cap; the old files are then kept and the pass reports an error instead of writing something corrupt.
- Automatic extraction needs the process alive during the idle window; otherwise the next boot's `backfill` catches up.
- Retrieval is keyword/line based, not semantic — the same tradeoff Codex makes. Route with `keywords` in `MEMORY.md`.

## Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). For anything
security-related, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead of opening a public issue. Release
history lives in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH plugin: enable permessage-deflate on the WebSocket transport (/api/remote.mux) without modifying the DSH install tree
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ws-deflate

**English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Turns on `permessage-deflate` for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) web's WebSocket transport, **without modifying the DSH installation**. Measured on one machine: a session transcript that left the server as **1,206,822 B went out as 350,599 B — 70.9 % fewer wire bytes**.

It is a **runtime monkey-patch, not a supported extension point.** Read "Should I install this" before installing it.

## Should I install this?

**Install it if** you open `dsh web` from somewhere that is not your own machine — a Tailscale/VPN link, a reverse proxy over the internet, any path with real latency or packet loss. DSH replays the whole session transcript over `/api/remote.mux` on every reconnect, so on a lossy link those bytes are paid repeatedly.

**Do not install it if** you only ever use `dsh web` on `localhost` or a LAN. The saving is real but you don't need it there, and what you'd be taking on in exchange is a patch against another project's internals that can go quietly stale on every upgrade.

What it costs, measured on a Windows 10 / node v24 box: **+10 ms** to `dsh` startup (alternating 4-run measurement), and zlib level 6 at **42.7 ms per 1.53 MB** of transcript. The compression is per-message above a 1 KiB threshold, so small events are untouched.

## What it actually changes

Nothing on disk. `ws@8.22.0`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib` were compared file-by-file (sha256) against the pristine registry tarballs: **63 files, 0 mismatches, 0 extra, 0 missing**, and 0 files in the install tree written or created that day.

What it does change is one method, in memory, in the `dsh` process:

```
BEFORE  WebSocketServer.prototype.handleUpgrade = handleUpgrade(req, socket, head, cb) {   ← ws's own
AFTER   WebSocketServer.prototype.handleUpgrade = function (req, socket, head, cb) { try {  ← the wrapper
disk sha256 of ws/lib/websocket-server.js: 6d8dd89a841748c8 -> 6d8dd89a841748c8            ← unchanged
```

The wrapper sets `this.options.perMessageDeflate` at **handshake** time, which works because ws 8.x reads that option inside `handleUpgrade` (`websocket-server.js:299`/`:303`), not at construction — so it reaches the gateway's already-built `new WebSocketServer({ noServer: true })` (`dsh-api-gateway/lib/index.js:179`). It only opts in when nothing else set the option, so **if DSH enables compression itself upstream, this plugin steps aside automatically.**

Why the option can't just be configured: DSH exposes no key for it. The webserver's `compression` is HTTP gzip and does not cover streams.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ws-deflate
```

Then restart `dsh web`. The bundle list is read at startup, so no restart means no effect.

## Verify

```bash
grep 'dsh-ws-deflate' <wherever your dsh web logs>
```

You want three things:

```
[dsh-ws-deflate] permessage-deflate enabled -> …/node_modules/ws [ws 8.22.0] via path (level 6, threshold 1024 B, noContextTakeover on)
[dsh-ws-deflate] self test OK: this process negotiates permessage-deflate
[dsh-ws-deflate] negotiated permessage-deflate with Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7) …
```

The **self test** is the interesting one. DSH's browser auth rejects non-browser handshakes, so you cannot probe a live server from a script — the plugin instead builds its own `new WebSocketServer({ noServer: true })` on an ephemeral loopback port and does a real handshake against it. That proves *this process, with this ws copy, negotiates*, which is the claim no external probe can reach. The `negotiated …` lines then log the first few real browser handshakes (user agent truncated, `maxLog` caps it at 5, `0` disables).

Browser side, if you want it: DevTools → Network → the `remote.mux` request → Response Headers should contain `Sec-WebSocket-Extensions: permessage-deflate; …`.

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-ws-deflate
```

Restart. Nothing needs restoring, because nothing on disk was ever different.

## Configuration

Add or edit the entry in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: ws-deflate
  name: dsh-ws-deflate
  config:
    enabled: true
    level: 6
    thresholdBytes: 1024
    noContextTakeover: true
    concurrencyLimit: 10
    selfTest: true
    maxLog: 5
```

| key | default | notes |
|---|---:|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` keeps the wrapper installed but opts no handshake in |
| `level` | `6` | measured here: level 6 → ratio 0.176, level 1 → 0.238 on the same payload, at 42.7 ms vs 5.9 ms per 1.53 MB |
| `thresholdBytes` | `1024` | below this, frames go out raw (the median DSH event is ~800 B) |
| `noContextTakeover` | `true` | independent deflate stream per frame: bounded memory, and a dropped frame cannot corrupt later messages. Costs ratio, buys robustness on a lossy link — which is the whole reason to run this plugin |
| `concurrencyLimit` | `10` | cap on simultaneous compress operations |
| `selfTest` | `true` | run the loopback handshake at activation. Not hot-reloadable |
| `maxLog` | `5` | how many successful negotiations to log; `0` is silent |

Everything except `selfTest` is `.volatile()`, so editing the patch and letting the profile hot-reload re-applies it without a restart.

## How it finds the gateway's `ws` copy

A plugin cannot `import 'ws'` and get the gateway's copy. The profile is a pnpm tree that contains no `ws` at all; declaring it as a dependency installs a **second** copy — a different class object, and patching it does nothing. Three routes, tried in this order, all tested:

1. **Ask the process.** The gateway's `ws` is in the CommonJS module cache; the class found there is provably the one the gateway uses (`cached === path-required: true`). Match on `ws/lib/websocket-server.js`, **not** `ws/index.js` — ws routes `import` to `wrapper.mjs`, which goes straight at the lib file, so `index.js` never enters the cache in an ESM host. Note `lib/websocket-server.js` does `module.exports = WebSocketServer`, so the export *is* the class.
2. **Guess the path.** Honours `$DSH_HOME` (precedence: configured path > `$DSH_HOME` > `~/.dsh`) and checks `<home>/profiles/node_modules/ws`, which dsh itself creates as a junction into the install tree — the most portable entry. Plus npm-global prefixes for Windows (`%APPDATA%\npm`), Linux (`/usr/local`, `/usr/lib`) and both macOS locations (`/usr/local`, `/opt/homebrew`).
3. **Retry for ~2 s.** If neither finds anything, retry every 250 ms (unref'd, so it can never hold the process open). This is what covers an install whose prefix is not in the list: by the time the gateway has loaded, route 1 works. Tested by neutralising every candidate (`DSH_HOME` + `APPDATA` + `argv[1]` pointed at empty dirs), activating — nothing patched — then loading the gateway late: `located ws on deferred attempt 2 … via require.cache`, self test OK.

### One thing that will confuse you, on purpose

`import 'dsh-ws-deflate'` from a plain `node` script **fails** with `Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'`, even though the plugin loads fine inside `dsh`. That is not a bug to fix: dsh runs its own interception resolver (`dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1459` `scope === "installation"`, `:1479` `readPeerNames(...).has(name)`) and supplies declared peers from the installation tree. A fresh profile has no `schemastery` anywhere in it — verified on two platforms — and the plugin still activates. **So don't "verify" this plugin by importing it from a script; verify it by restarting `dsh web` and reading the log.**

## Tested on

| platform | node | dsh | ws | pnpm | result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windows 10 | v24.20.0 | 0.2.0-rc.2 | 8.22.0 | 10.18.2 | live, 3 browser handshakes logged incl. macOS Safari |
| Linux | v22.19.0 | 0.2.0-rc.2 | 8.22.0 | 12.11.2 | clean-room: fresh profile from the shipped template, installed from a packed tarball, booted on :3099, self test OK |

Both were installed from a local tarball, not from the registry. One combination per platform — treat anything else as untested. The structural guard is `typeof WebSocketServer.prototype.handleUpgrad

plugins.description: DSH 插件：通过 SSH 连接远程主机，定位/拉取二进制或固件，调用 REA 做逆向分析。只分析不利用，支持 POSIX shell 目标，Windows 远端显式拒绝。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-remote-rea

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）生态插件：**远程连接 + 逆向分析** —— 连上远程主机，定位/拉取目标文件，
调用 REA（及其背后的 Ghidra / Hopper / IDA）做静态分析并回收结构化结果。

**只分析、不利用**：本插件不执行目标、不注入、不改写工件、不做任何利用动作。所有远端命令都先过
提权闸门（见「安全边界」）。

## 三个工具

| 工具 | 作用 | 关键入参 |
|---|---|---|
| `remote_hosts` | 主机库 CRUD：登记别名、认证方式、连通性 `test`、从 `~/.ssh/config` 导入 | `action` + `alias` … |
| `remote_fetch_binary` | 预检（存在 / 大小 / 类型 / sha256）→ 拉取 → 本地复算 sha 比对 → 写 JSON 报告 | `alias`、`remotePath`（绝对路径） |
| `remote_rea_analyze` | 拉取之后探测能力面、选 provider/operation、下发分析子命令、Evidence 落盘并出摘要 | `alias`、`remotePath`、可选 `provider` |

用之前必须先在 `remote_hosts` 里有别名 —— 主机库是这两个分析工具的前置条件，本插件不读任何外部口令。

`remote_rea_analyze` 不指定 `provider` 时自动路由，选路范围是
「REA 广告面 ∩ 已用 `--help` 核对过绑定的子命令」，两者取交集，缺一个就不下发。

## 支持范围

| 层面 | 支持 | 不支持时的行为 |
|---|---|---|
| 宿主 OS | Windows / macOS / Linux | 不可能不支持（`ssh2` 是纯 JS 实现，原生加速模块可选） |
| 宿主 Node | `>=18`（建议 20+） | 由 `package.json` 的 `engines.node` 声明；安装器告警，本插件自身不做版本检查 |
| 远程 OS | POSIX shell（Linux / macOS） | 运行时探测 `uname -s`，命中 `MINGW*`/`MSYS*`/`CYGWIN*`/`Windows*` 直接拒：`不支持的目标平台：Windows 远端，请使用 POSIX shell 目标` |
| 远程 Node | 22.19+ / 24.11+ / 26+（不支持 23 和 25） | 走 npx 前先探 `node --version`，不达标报一句话：`远端 <版本>；REA 要求 Node 22.19+ / 24.11+ / 26+（不支持 23 和 25）`，且**不下发任何 rea 命令** |
| 远程工具 | GNU coreutils，或可降级的子集 | 见下面「预检的降级路径」，每条都有兜底而不是直接失败 |

> 宿主 Node 的 `>=18` 是声明值，未在 18 上实测：本项目的开发/回归环境只有 Windows 侧 node 24.x
> 与 WSL 侧 node 22.22.1。用到的语法（ESM、可选链、空值合并、`node:` 前缀内置模块）都在 18 以内。

### 预检的降级路径

- `stat -c %s` 拿不到大小（BSD/macOS 的 `stat` 不认 `%s`）→ 退回 `wc -c <`；两条都失败 → `sizeBytes=null`。
- `file -b` 失败 → `fileType=null`，路由降级为「按扩展名猜类别」，note 里写明「未经格式头证实」；
  扩展名也认不出来就报 `未知类型：file -b 没有输出、扩展名也认不出来；深度分析需指定 provider`。
- 远端既没有全局 `rea` 也没有 `npx` → `远端无 npx，请安装 Node.js 22.19+ 或全局安装 rea`。
- 符号链接：`file -b` 回的是 `symbolic link to …`，而 `stat -c %s` 给的是链接字符串长度、
  `sha256sum`/SFTP 跟随目标 —— 所以链接目标的 `sizeMatches=null` + `sizeSkippedForSymlink=true`，**sha 才是权威**。

## 已知限制

- **Ghidra 路径已接，未实装验证。** 绑定表见 `rea-provider-router.js` 的 `GHIDRA_BINDINGS`（5 条，
  只有 `--help` 证据、没有任何一次真机跑通），因此**不参与自动选路**，只在调用方显式
  `provider:"ghidra"` 且 REA readiness 判它可用时才走。要实装需自备 **Ghidra 12.1.x** 解包目录并把
  `GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR` 指过去，外加 **JDK 21**（便携 JDK 也行，只要 PATH 上有 `java`）。
- **`analyze-javascript-application` 不在 capabilities 广告面**（providers / capabilities / doctor 三处都没有它），
  作为带标记的**手工例外**接入：`surface='manual-exception'`、`marker='manual-exception:not-advertised'`。
  它的 effects 是空的 —— 也就是「读文件还是写文件系统」REA 自己没说，本项目也不替它猜。
- **`rea-artifact-graph` 只做 inventory，`findings=0` 是结构性的**，不是「这个二进制很干净」：它的 Evidence
  方言里没有 `semantic_graph`，摘要层的 `dialect` 计数会把 `unexplored_branches` / `next_probes` 原样透传，
  深度要靠 Ghidra 那一条路。
- **冷缓存预热可能 50s 到 10 分钟不等**，取决于网络。实测区间 50–83s，但同一条路出现过 120s、420s，
  以及 2026-10-17 在 WSL 上实测的 **534s**（清缓存后用默认预算跑通整链）。`npxTimeoutMs` 因此定为 600000，
  可按调用覆盖。
- **`doctor` 原文不是字节稳定的**：`identity.installations.paths[0]` 会随 npx 缓存位置变化，所以本项目
  不对 doctor 原文做逐字节断言，只按 evidence_id / 字段取用。
- **`@latest` 可能漂移**：`npx --yes rea-agents@latest` 每次解析到的版本可能不同。遇到缓存或行为对不上，
  可把远端命令手动锁成 `rea-agents@<版本>`。
- **`pnpm peers check` 的 missing peer 是静态误报**：DSH profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 设了
  `autoInstallPeers: false`，pnpm 只看 profile 自己的 `package.json`，看不到上层
  `profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/`，于是报 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` / `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 缺失。
  实测：那两个 peer 由 DSH 运行时自带 —— `profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/{cordis,dsh-tools}`
  是指向全局 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 内嵌依赖的符号链接（本机解析到 cordis 4.0.2、dsh-tools 0.1.5-rc.2）。
  插件是从 tarball 解出来的**真实目录**，从它内部 `import.meta.resolve()` 向上走就能命中；
  已装的 dsh-dolphin-security 报的是同一类误报。**只要实际版本落在 peer 范围内，这条警告可以忽略。**

## 跨平台说明

- 开发环境用 **WSL 做真机测试**：Windows → WSL2 的 2222 portproxy 需要管理员权限才能修，本机没修，
  所以 Windows 侧只跑离线套件（逻辑层 + 假 engine），真机套件在 WSL 内部跑。
- `cpu-features` 构建失败**不影响功能**：`ssh2` 把它列为可选加速模块，装不上就退回纯 JS 实现，只是性能略降。
  （这条是 ssh2 上游行为 + 本项目 `loadSsh2`/`isSsh2Available` 的容错设计；我们没有专门实测过构建失败的安装。）
- `REVERSE_HOME` 用**当前 OS 的路径风格**：Windows 上是 `D:\...`，POSIX 上是 `/...`，本项目不做路径翻译。

## 安全边界

- **只分析、不利用**：没有执行目标、注入、patch、改写工件的任何入口。
- **提权硬闸门**：每条远端命令下发前过 `assertNoPrivilegeEscalation`，命中 `sudo` 或
  `--break-system-packages` 直接抛错、不下发（`remote-shell-utils.js`）。探测类命令 `attempts` 固定为 1，
  不做重放 —— 下发前无法确认幂等。
- **`mutates_artifact` 的操作不会被选中**，机制要说准：REA 广告面里确实有带它的组
  （`annotate_native_function`、`set_address_name(s)`、`set_bookmark` / `set_comment` / `set_inline_comment` /
  `unset_bookmark`），但选路的必要条件是「该操作有已核对的 CLI 绑定」，而绑定表里一条写类操作都没有。
  也就是说这是**靠白名单实现的，不是运行期按 effects 拦截**；`effects` 只如实透传进 `route.reason` 给你看。
- **口令不进工具参数**：`authKind=password` 只接受一个环境变量名 `passwordEnv`，口令本体留在宿主进程环境里 ——
  作为参数传会进会话记录。列表/详情回的是脱敏投影（`auth.kind`），不回显口令或私钥内容。

## A 路（Ghidra 深分析）绑定表

| operation | 子命令（`--help` 原文形状） | address |
|---|---|---|
| `analyze_function` | `rea function <path> [address] [options]` | 可选 |
| `procedure_pseudo_code` | `rea decompile <path> [address] [options]` | 可选 |
| `procedure_assembly` | `rea instructions <path> [address] [options]` | 可选 |
| `xrefs` | `rea xrefs <path> [address] [options]` | 可选 |
| `read_bytes` | `rea read-bytes <path> <address> [options]` | **必填 → 只登记不下发** |

Ghidra 不可用时，错误信息用的是 REA 自己的原文（`Set GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR to an extracted Ghidra 12.1.x
release directory.` ＋ `install_dir / analyze_headless_path / java_command / java_home` 的诊断原值），
本项目不自己编修法。深分析 provider 的 session 是 ephemeral（导入的 Program 与临时工程在 close 时删除），
所以 Evidence 一解析出来就当场落盘。

## 落盘位置

数据根 = `$REVERSE_HOME`（回退 `$DSH_HOME`，再回退 `~/.reverse`）：

- 报告：`<数据根>/reports/fetch-<alias>-<ts>.json`、`analyze-<alias>-<ts>.json`
- 拉取的目标：`<数据根>/targets/<文件名>`
- Evidence：按 `evidence_id` 落盘（`<数据根>/evidence/<evidence_id>.json`），路径写在报告的
  `analysis.evidencePath`；落的是 stdout 里那一行**原始字节**，不重新格式化。

工具返回体里不放远端原始 stdout，也不放全量 Evidence（真机 5.6KB ~ 75KB），只放摘要与路径。

## 安装与挂载

```bash
cd <DSH home> && DSH_HOME=<DSH home> dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remote-rea
cd <项目根> && DSH_HOME=<DSH home> dsh --profile web --host 127.0.0.1 --no-open
```

`ssh2` / `cpu-features` 需要构建许可：pnpm 11 的门禁会拦依赖的构建脚本
（`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`，退出码 1），要在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里加上

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  cpu-features: true
  ssh2: true
```

装完要重启 `dsh web` 并强制刷新浏览器。桌面端（`desktop` profile）由 Electron 独占管理，
命令行装插件会被拒（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`），
入口是应用内的插件管理器。

## 测试

```bash
node test/run-tests.mjs              # 3a 本地解析层
node test/run-probe-tests.mjs        # 3b 远端能力面探测（--offline 只跑逻辑层）
node test/run-deploy-tests.mjs       # 第 4 步 部署链
node test/run-controller-tests.mjs   # 第 5 步 runFetch
node test/run-analyze-tests.mjs      # 第 6 步 runAnalyze（--cold 额外跑破坏性冷缓存）
node test/run-plugin-tests.mjs       # 第 7 步 插件契约 + 跨平台补丁 + A 路
```

需要真机的套件走 `--alias=<别名> --store=<主机库路径>`，别名先用 `remote_hosts` 或主机库脚本登记。

## 许可与第三方声明

本项目以 MIT 发布（`LICENSE`）。`remote-ssh-core.js` 派生自 dsh-web 的 `dsh-ssh`（Apache-2.0），
`remote-shell-utils.js` 派生自 dsh-dolphin-security（MIT，同作者）—— 逐函数的来源位置、修改内容与
许可证原文见 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` 与 `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/`。

技术债与已知限制的单子在同目录 `TECH_DEBT.md`。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 用の日本語ネイティブ TUI（設計段階 / design phase）
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH-forJP-TUI

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) のための**日本語ネイティブ TUI**。

> **状態: Phase 0（走路骨格）完了。描画は未着手。**
> 自作バンドルが DSH の Cordis 木に載り、自前の入口（C）から起動し、C が壊れれば
> `dsh --profile` 子プロセス（B）へフォールバックし、`session/event` の生イベントを捕捉できる。
> 検証は `node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs`（12検査）。

## これは何か

dsh の TUI サーフェスを、日本語を第一級に扱う形で自作する。
既存の [dsh-TUI](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI) を参考にしつつ、
コードは共有せず、描画層から自分で設計する。

## 目的

| # | 目的 | 設計要求 |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | 見た目を自分で設計できる | 描画層を自前で握る。装飾演出を既定で入れない |
| P2 | 日本語ネイティブ | 文言を最初からカタログ化。日本語を言語パックに追い出さない |
| P3 | 上流更新で崩れにくい | 依存する上流の非公開契約を最小化し、その数を常時計測する |
| P4 | UX 研究の土台 | UI 層とハーネス層を分離し、UI の反復試行を安くする |
| P5 | 将来ハーネスごと差し替える（思想として保持） | ハーネス境界を1箇所に閉じ込める |
| P6 | ハーネスチューニング研究 | ハーネスの挙動を外から差し替え可能に保つ |

## 確定している方針

- **DSH への載せ方**: in-process の Cordis バンドル（`dsh.bundle.patch`）。承認・ユーザー質問・モデル切替を
  人対話で行うには、これ以外の経路が存在しない（公式 SDK / ACP には承認チャネルが無い）
- **起動**: 自前のフル host-entry を持つ。ただし**失敗時は必ず `dsh --profile` 子プロセスへフォールバック**する
- **描画層**: upstream の [Ink](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink) **v8.0.0**（commit `26d2c3f8`）を fork し、
  `src/ink/` に置いて自前で拡張する。Ink 本体はマウス選択・ヒットテスト・スクロール固定を持たないため、
  これらは自作する
- **v0 の範囲**: 入力解析 / 差分描画 / 全角幅 / 入力欄 / ストリーム表示 / ツールカード /
  承認パネル / ユーザー質問パネル / セッション結線 / 中断と終了

## ドキュメント

> **作業を引き継ぐ場合は [`docs/HANDOFF.md`](docs/HANDOFF.md) を先に読んでください。**
> 今の状態・動かし方・アーキテクチャ・DSH の API で実測した落とし穴・既知の穴・次の課題が
> そこに集約されています。

| 文書 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [`docs/design/0001-architecture-and-roadmap.md`](docs/design/0001-architecture-and-roadmap.md) | **設計書とロードマップ**（決定ログ D1〜D9、Phase -1〜5、リスク R1〜R8） |
| [`docs/reports/2026-10-18-phase0-walking-skeleton.md`](docs/reports/2026-10-18-phase0-walking-skeleton.md) | **Phase 0 完了レポート**（達成項目・設計を変えた発見・やっていないこと） |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-bundle-authoring.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-bundle-authoring.md) | バンドル／Cordis プラグインの書き方（公式実物からの抽出） |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-headless-recipe.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-headless-recipe.md) | 公式 `dsh-headless` から抽出したエージェント駆動手順 |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-sandbox-and-dsh-home.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-sandbox-and-dsh-home.md) | 実行環境の制約と `DSH_HOME` 差し替えによる検証方法 |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-integration-surfaces.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-integration-surfaces.md) | DSH の統合面・バンドル契約・SDK プロトコル・Ink 反証 |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-core-public-surface.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-core-public-surface.md) | DSH 本体の公開インターフェース |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-tui-seam.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-tui-seam.md) | 参考実装が DSH とどう接続しているか |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-tui-feature-inventory.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-tui-feature-inventory.md) | 参考実装の機能・UX 棚卸し |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-renderer-options.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-renderer-options.md) | TypeScript TUI レンダラ基盤の比較 |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-third-party-tui-web.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-third-party-tui-web.md) | DSH と第三者 TUI の外部情報 |

調査ノートには**環境依存のローカル絶対パスをマスク**してある（`$HOME/<workspace>/...`）。

## 開発

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs          # 構造検査（A〜D）
COMMANDCODE_API_KEY=... node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs   # 実モデル実行まで（E）
```

検証は `$HOME/.dsh` に**一切書き込まない**。`DSH_HOME` をワークスペース内の `.dsh-home/` に向けて
プロファイルとバンドル解決を完結させる（[理由](docs/research/2026-10-18-sandbox-and-dsh-home.md)）。

入口は `lib/bin.js`（`dsh-forjp`）。環境変数で挙動を切り替えられる:

| 変数 | 値 | 意味 |
|---|---|---|
| `FORJP_ENTRY` | `auto`（既定） | C を試し、失敗したら B へフォールバック |
| | `in-process` | C のみ。失敗したら異常終了 |
| | `child` | B を強制 |
| `FORJP_PROFILE` | 既定 `forjp` | プロファイル名 |
| `DSH_FORJP_HOST_PACKAGE` | 未設定 | ホスト `@deepseek-ai/dsh` のパッケージディレクトリを明示 |

## ライセンス

MIT（[`LICENSE`](LICENSE)）。

fork 元の [Ink](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink) も MIT であり、`src/ink/` に取り込む時点で
Ink のライセンス表示を同梱する。

## TUI を起動する（縦切り v0.1）

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm profile:install                 # $DSH_HOME（既定 ~/.dsh）へプロファイルを設置
COMMANDCODE_API_KEY=... dsh --profile forjp-tui
```

- 入力して `Enter` で送信、`Ctrl+C` または `Esc` 2回で終了
- 動作確認（PTY 上で起動→入力→応答→終了までを実測する）: `pnpm test:ui`
- **別の版の DSH で動くか**: `pnpm verify:host --host <dsh のパッケージディレクトリ>`
- 作業用の隔離環境へ入れる場合: `pnpm profile:install --home .dsh-home`
