中文 · English · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

介绍 · 对比 · 证明 · 机制 · 快速开始 · 能力 · 配置 · 更新

> **这是踏雪寻仙 DeepSeek Harness 插件系列的一员**（[dsh-files](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-files) 39★ · [dsh-models](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-models) 模型选择 + 子代理路由 + 推理层级）。同作者完整技能系列：[session-digger](https://github.com/taxueseek/session-digger) 29★ · [taxue-invest](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-invest) 21★ · [taxueskills](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxueskills) 23★ · [taxue-creative-style](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-creative-style) 12★ ## 它和「模型自带搜索 / AI 搜索 / 聚合搜索」比，强在哪 > 简单来说：前三种方案解决「**人**找信息」，Argo 解决「**Agent 及搜索核查于一身，具备一条龙的搜索服务**」。差别不在界面，在交付物，给人看的叫总结页或链接清单，给 Agent 的应是能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的优质内容，更可靠的搜索信息。

| 维度 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 垂直问题（行情 / 化学式） | 泛搜网页 | 泛搜再总结 | 泛搜网页 | **直连垂直源，直接给答案** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 重复查询 | 每次都打网 | 每次都打网 | 靠页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | > 机制上，Argo 把搜索当成一条**证据管线**：语言检测 → 领域路由 → 多引擎召回 → RRF 融合 → 证据快评，交付的是 Agent 可直接排序、可 `fetch` 复核、不撑爆上下文的材料。工具链不用换，需要换的是「搜索结果应该长什么样」——再往下一层，还有和「再包一层搜索 API 的差别」，那是实现细节的对比。 --- ## 2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- ## 这是什么 **Argo 是给 AI Agent 用的多语言搜索基础设施。** 真实检索从来不是「一种语言 + 一个搜索框」：有人问 A 股行情，有人问 World Cup，有人用日文找动画，有人要 IMDb 上的导演信息。Argo 的出发点很朴素——**按领域、按语言、按需求选路**，把问题送到合适的源，而不是一律扫网页标题。联网搜索与本机文件搜索一体可用。 > 产出不是「链接清单」，而是「证据候选 + 可信度分解」。路选对了，证据才站得住。 ### 和「再包一层搜索 API」的差别 | 常见做法 | Argo | |---------|------| | 绑死一个引擎、一个 Key | 多引擎自动选路，免费优先、可配预算 | | 啥问题都泛搜网页 | **垂直源优先**：行情、影视、体育、宏观、化学等先给答案型结果 | | 默认只按中英优化 | **多语言识别 + 引擎语言参数 + 跨语言回退** | | 搜完直接拼摘要 | 选择门槛 × 证据密度 × 时效 × 多源共识 | | 引擎挂了整条链路挂 | 熔断、负缓存、分阶恢复（防垂直源串味） | | 每次查询都重新打网 | 双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms 级 | | 日常和研究一个慢 | **日常少开引擎、研究再放宽** | | Agent 上下文被长 JSON 撑爆 | MCP 响应可紧凑裁剪，snippet 可控 | --- ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查询（来源 / 对比 / 主体） --- ## 快速开始 任选一种即可。**以 GitHub 为唯一安装来源**（`npx github:taxueseek/argo` 或 `install.sh` / `install.ps1`），当前推荐 **v2.9.6**。**请勿用 `npm install argo-search`**——npm registry 上那份是**非官方陈旧版 v1.0.1**（非本仓库维护，功能残缺、不随本项目更新）。本包 `package.json` 已设 `private: true` 防止误发布到 npm registry。 **零配置就能跑**：不配 API Key 时走免费引擎 + 本地 `local_*` 引擎；配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过。 ### 方式一：一键脚本（推荐本机长期用） macOS / Linux： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` Windows（PowerShell）： ```powershell powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex" # 或下载后执行： # powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install.ps1 ``` 装到指定目录、并挂 Skill 入口： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh \ | bash -s -- --home "$HOME/.local/share/argo" --link "$HOME/.claude/skills/argo" ``` 验证： ```bash python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py "python asyncio error handling" --json python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py --list-engines ``` ### 方式二：MCP 不装包，直接用 GitHub（推荐 Agent 快速挂载） 需要 **Node.js 18+** 和 **Python 3.9+**，首次执行一次： ```bash pip3 install pyyaml ``` ```bash npx -y github:taxueseek/argo ``` 客户端配置示例（Claude Code / Cursor / Kimi 等）： ```json { "mcpServers": { "argo": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "github:taxueseek/argo"] } } } ``` ### DeepSeek Harness 一键插件（.dsh-plugin bundle） 在 DeepSeek Harness 里一行安装（两种装法）： ```bash # 装法 A：19 个 mcp__argo__* 工具（主包自带 bundle，与 MCP 全量相同） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo" # 装法 B：搜索工具 + wide_research 并行研究调度（子包） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo#main&path:packages/dsh-plugin" ``` 重启 `dsh web` 后生效。包结构见 `packages/dsh-plugin/`；同 id `mcp-argo` / `wide-research` 可在用户层 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖。装法 B 的 `wide_research` 模块只存在于子包依赖树，主包 patch 不引用它，避免只装主包时 Cordis 解析失败。DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 与 0.2.1-rc.2 均已实测：rc.2 上 `wide_research`（2 worker，passed=true / 14 sources）与原生 `argo_search`（count=3）真跑通，`dsh web` 启动无 argo 报错；web seam 随启动注册通过（headless 无 web 服务，未做实际调用）。 ### 依赖清单（通俗版） | 依赖 | 必需？ | 干什么用 | 不装会怎样 | |------|:------:|---------|-----------| | **PyYAML** | ✅ 必需 | 读配置文件 | 完全跑不起来，安装脚本会自动装 | | **curl_cffi** | ❌ 可选（v2.7.3 新增） | 模拟浏览器 TLS 指纹，过反爬站（Cloudflare 等） | 反爬站抓取成功率低一些，日常搜索无影响 | | **rapidfuzz** | ❌ 可选（v2.9.5 新增） | 去重的模糊近重复复核：同文换站后缀/镜像站在 minhash 近似命中带内二次判定 | 跨站同文少合几条，去重召回略降；站后缀归一仍生效 | | **ddgs CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 本地免 key 搜索的 10 个后端引擎 | 少一批零成本本地搜索源，其余不受影响 | | **realtime-index CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 实时索引引擎（搜刚发布的内容） | 该引擎自动禁用，显式指定会回退通用

plugins.description: Live multi-way tree of the current session's agents in DeepSeek Harness, with status, plan progress, tokens, cost, and runtime on every card.
plugins.readme_text:
# Agent Trees / 智能体树

**Agent Trees / 智能体树** — a DeepSeek Harness UI plugin that renders the current
session's agent workflow as a live multi-way tree, in a top-down chart layout by
default. It is a standard DSH bundle (`dsh.bundle`) with a Web Client half and no
build step.

**中文简介**：在 DeepSeek Harness 的对话页和右侧边栏中以多叉树展示当前会话的智能体工作流；每个卡片显示状态、计划进度、Token、费用和运行时间。

Each agent is a compact card ("小方块") with a minimal 1px outline:

- the task it owns (the delegation label, or the session title when no label exists),
- a top-left status indicator — a small spinner while running, a green dot on
  success, a red dot on failure, and a grey dot otherwise,
- a `P0`–`P3` priority badge,
- a static progress bar based on its todo plan (no flowing animation),
- a footer with current tokens, USD cost, main/subagent role, and live duration.

The current session is the highlighted card. When the current session is itself a
subagent, the tree walks up to the topmost available parent and marks the current
agent in the family tree.

## Install

The plugin is prepared for the [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)
catalog through [`awesome-dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin).
Once the catalog entry is live, search **Agent Trees / 智能体树** in
**Settings → Plugin Market**.

You can install it directly from the repository now:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xiezouqu12/agent-trees
```

On DSH Desktop, install from **Settings → Plugins** (the desktop app owns its
profile, so the CLI does not change the running app's profile).

Repository: [xiezouqu12/agent-trees](https://github.com/xiezouqu12/agent-trees).
Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0`.

## Screenshots

![Agent Trees in the conversation view](screenshot-main.png)

![Agent Trees in the right sidebar](screenshot-sidebar.png)

## Where it appears

Open a conversation and select the **Agent Trees / 智能体树** tab next to
**Chat**, **Trajectory**, and the other views. The tab is added through the
`conversation.view` Client slot.

It also opens in the **right sidebar**:

- Click the small tree icon in the conversation header (next to the sidebar
  toggle) to open or focus the **Agent Trees** sidebar tab in one click.
- The right sidebar's `+` guide lists an **Agent Trees** capsule, so the tab can
  also be opened from there.
- The sidebar tab is a native `sidebar.right.pane.tab` body with a compact
  layout, and it stays open beside the chat while the session changes.

The sidebar is **not** opened automatically for an ordinary session. It opens
when you click the header tree icon or pick the capsule from the sidebar `+`
guide. A long multi-agent task may auto-open it once after **3+ agents** have had
at least one running for about **25 seconds**, and only while the sidebar is
collapsed; a simple project never triggers it.

### Layouts

The view opens in **Chart** layout: a top-down org chart with rounded cards and
smooth curved connectors on a graph-paper canvas that fills the remaining panel
height (the whole sidebar body in the right-sidebar tab). Drag anywhere on the
canvas background to pan the whole tree; use the mouse wheel to zoom around the
cursor (35%–250%); double-click the background to reset pan and zoom. The canvas
hint shows the current zoom percentage. Each card shows the task, priority,
status, progress, tokens, cost, role, and runtime. Collapse a branch with the
round chevron at the card's bottom edge; the chart reflows immediately.

The two icon buttons in the header switch between **Chart** and **List** (the
indented tree). The same layout applies to the conversation tab and the
right-sidebar tab.

## How the data is derived

The plugin is Client-only and reads existing client-visible session projections —
it writes no session events and registers no Host route:

| Projection | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `subagentCatalog` | parent → child topology, delegation mode, task label |
| `subagentTiming` | last-turn completion, settled/active duration |
| `tokenUsage` | per-agent token total |
| `costUsage` | per-agent token buckets and USD cost (when `dsh-cost-meter` is mounted) |
| `todos` | per-agent task progress, when the agent used `todo_write` |

Session summaries (`useSessions().byId`) supply titles, running state, `blank`,
and the parent link. `useSessionStatus` supplies the live status map.

### Progress rules

1. If the agent has a todo list, progress is
   `(completed + 0.5 × in_progress) / total`, and the card shows `done/total`.
2. A running agent without a todo plan shows a static empty track labelled
   `无计划`; the top-left spinner indicates that it is running. Nothing flows or
   animates.
3. A finished agent whose latest closed turn completed shows 100% and a green
   status dot.
4. A finished agent whose todo list is fully completed is also 100%, even when
   the timing projection has not settled yet.
5. A finished subagent whose latest closed turn did not complete shows a red
   status dot; its bar stays at its actual todo progress, or `无计划` when it had
   no plan.
6. A blank, not-yet-started agent shows 0% and a grey dot.
7. External tasks (`mode: "external"`) have no local session, so their bar is
   neutral and labelled "外部".
8. The **main agent** is never marked red just for being idle between turns: it
   shows a grey idle dot. Red is reserved for a subagent that ended without
   completing. The main agent's todo projection is cleared at each turn start, so
   the card shows `无计划` until a new plan is written; it keeps the last plan it
   observed.

The header's overall percentage follows the main task's todo plan when the root
has one, so a small finished child cannot inflate the main task. When the main
task is running without a todo plan it uses the finished-agent ratio instead;
otherwise it averages the per-agent progress values that are known. The value is
shown inline with the agent counts; hover it for the estimate source.

### Priority rules

- By default priority follows depth: root = `P0`, direct children = `P1`,
  grandchildren = `P2`, deeper = `P3`.
- A delegation label may override it with a leading `[P0]`, `P1:`, `P0 -`, etc.
  prefix; the prefix is removed from the displayed task title.

### Order

Cards no longer display sequence numbers (`#01`, `#02`, …). Siblings keep the
parent catalog's event order, and the tree position itself conveys the workflow
order.

## Interactions

- Click a card to open that agent's conversation (the current card is inert).
- Click the header tree icon to open or focus the right-sidebar tab.
- Drag the canvas background to pan the tree; use the mouse wheel to zoom around
  the cursor; double-click the background to reset pan and zoom.
- Switch between chart and list with the two header layout icons.
- In chart layout, use the round chevron at the bottom of a card to collapse its
  branch; in list layout, use the chevron at the left of the row.
- The refresh icon re-reads projections for every visible agent.
- The header keeps a compact one-line summary: agents, running, done, overall
  percentage, and token total. There is no separate progress card, search bar,
  filter row, or legend taking up tree space.
- Keyboard: `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` move between cards, `ArrowRight` /
  `ArrowLeft` expand or collapse, `Home` / `End` jump to the ends, `Enter` /
  `Space` opens.

Projection updates arrive through the normal Client store, so topology, status,
todos, duration, and token counts update live. A one-second clock refreshes
durations while any agent runs.

## Compatibility

Built and tested against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` (the version in this
desktop install). The package declares `engines.dsh: >=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0`.
It depends only on the Web Client slot surface and the standard session hooks:

- `conversation.view` slot with `sessionId`, `useSessions`, `useSessionStatus`
- `ctx.sessions.refreshProjections`
- `ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession`
- `ctx.locale` and `ctx.slots`

No Harness Client package is imported as a module; React comes from the browser
module table.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half (metadata only) |
| `client.js` |

plugins.description: An AI next-move advisor for DeepSeek Harness. Find a better next step, then press Tab to make it yours.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH ACE

**Beyond the obvious.**

An AI next-move advisor for **DeepSeek Harness**. It reads the recent conversation and shows **one** card: it restates the thing you are answering, names the relation behind it, points at one other place that relation shows up, and ends with a checkable move. Press `Tab` to insert only that move; nothing is sent automatically.

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Tests](https://github.com/Ghoscro/dsh-ace/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Ghoscro/dsh-ace/actions/workflows/test.yml)

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

![ACE Move example](docs/demo.svg)

> Rendered example, not a recording. A real screen capture replaces it before the first release.

**The difference, in one line:** autocomplete guesses what you *would* type; ACE reorders something you already know until the reaction is "right, why didn't I see that" — and shows nothing when nothing wins.

## Install

The npm name `dsh-ace` is taken by an unrelated project, so the package is scoped as `@ghoscro/dsh-ace`. Until it is published, the tarball on [Releases](https://github.com/Ghoscro/dsh-ace/releases) is the install path:

```bash
# in the DSH profile directory
pnpm add file:/absolute/path/to/ghoscro-dsh-ace-0.5.1.tgz
```

Then add `"@ghoscro/dsh-ace"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`, materialize the profile (DSH plugin page or `pnpm install`), and restart DSH. The composer row shows **✦ ACE** (**✦ 深度预测** in the Chinese UI).

Developer install (copy this directory into `sakura/packages/`) is at the end of [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md). Verified host: **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**; other versions are unverified.

## What it does

Most next-message tools optimize for **what you would probably type**. ACE optimizes for **whether this move is worth sending**, and whether it lets you see the next layer yourself.

**The four-beat card:**

> You just said X → the line behind it is Y → so Z will behave the same way → try W first; if you see such-and-such, I was wrong

- **X** restates the concrete thing in your own words (usually the assistant line you are answering).
- **Y** states the relation in one human sentence: why it works or fails. At most one abstraction.
- **Z** gives one other place the same relation shows up. If it does not look alike on the surface, the card carries a separate line saying how it maps; if it cannot, this beat scores zero.
- **W** is a checkable action for today: engineers get a file or command, everyone else gets something they can see ("refresh and look whether the badge is still red").
- **Wrong if:** what result would prove the card wrong.

**Three plain lines on every card:**

- **Now:** what is happening and where it is stuck, in symptoms you can see.
- **Why:** the result this step is for, not the action.
- **After:** what you will see or get, specific enough to judge "is this what I want".

One missing line and the card is not shown. Wild mode is included: the line `Tab` inserts must be readable at the current level, not a stack of unexplained terms.

- It generates 3–5 directions internally: advance, use an existing tool, reframe, verify, clarify, constrain, close.
- It scores them for `value`, `novelty`, `worth_extra_step`, and action type. The relation beat is judged by the host, not scored by the model: a surface-alike example needs no mapping line, and a surface-unlike example with no written mapping is not shown at all.
- **Level:** the card reads the user's own messages and adapts — everyday language and one action at a time for non-engineers, shorthand and judgement for engineers. Override it with `level` in the plugin config.
- The default mode answers a specific line of the assistant's last message (`reply_to`, quoted verbatim), but picks the answer worth sending, not the smoothest one.
- It shows **one** card, with X/Y/Z/W and its falsifier.
- If nothing beats the obvious “continue”, it shows **nothing**. A quiet card is a feature.
- `Tab` inserts only W. You can edit it. ACE never sends for you.

## Demo

The card above is the intended loop:

1. The assistant asks, “run the full suite?”
2. The obvious next line is “run it”.
3. The card: X “run the full suite?” → Y the retry swallows the flake, so a full run only spreads the odds → Z upload retries and CI flaky reruns are the same mechanism → W “remove the retry and run this one case once”.
4. “Wrong if”: one clean run means the retry was not masking anything.
5. `Tab` inserts only W; you decide whether to send.

## Quick start

1. Install as above; restart DSH.
2. Open a conversation. The composer row shows **✦ ACE**; click it, or wait for the next completed turn if automatic ACE is on.
3. Press `Tab` on the card to fill the draft.

If you are migrating from `dsh-composer-predict`, read [MIGRATION.md](MIGRATION.md) first. Do not load both packages at once.

**A missing card is not a failure.** It means nothing beat the obvious "continue" for that turn. Silent turns are logged as `no-card`, and the score threshold can be swept offline with `npm run sweep` instead of being tuned on live chats.

## Three cases

These are examples, not a controlled benchmark. They show the kind of added value ACE is aiming for.

### 1. A test that may be hiding the bug

- **Obvious:** “Run the full suite.”
- **ACE Move:** “Remove the retry and run this one test once; compare repeated runs with and without retries; a higher failure rate would support the masking hypothesis.”
- **What it adds:** it tests the mechanism instead of increasing the sample size.
- **Risk:** the test may fail for an unrelated reason.

### 2. A cheaper implementation path

- **Obvious:** “Write a small script to batch this.”
- **ACE Move:** “Use the existing CLI’s `--json` output and pipe it; no new script to maintain.”
- **What it adds:** a smaller surface area and a faster path to the same outcome.
- **Risk:** the CLI may not expose the field you need.

### 3. A task that is drifting

- **Obvious:** “Keep polishing the current card.”
- **ACE Move:** “The card is not the bottleneck; the install step still fails on a fresh profile. Fix that before the visual polish.”
- **What it adds:** it names the real constraint and changes the order of work.
- **Risk:** the install failure may be environment-specific.

## How it works

1. The browser sends the recent transcript and the session `cwd` to the host route.
2. The host builds a bounded, read-only evidence pack from `git` (status, diff stat, last commit, a bounded diff).
3. A deterministic situation block is built from the last user goal, the assistant’s last offer, and explicit constraints. There is no separate situation-model call.
4. **One** model call returns 3–5 line-delimited JSON candidates plus a selection line.
5. The host scores and selects exactly one move. Fixed slot order is gone; `verify`/`constrain` candidates are penalized so “check again” cannot win by default.
6. If the best score is below the threshold, the plugin returns no card.
7. `Tab` fills the draft. The card’s `why`/`evidence`/`risk` are not sent with the message.

The parser scans balanced JSON objects and skips a truncated or malformed line while keeping valid earlier candidates. A bad line does not discard the whole response.

## Settings and cost

- **Modes:** `safe`, `standard`, `brainstorm`, `wild` (labelled **ACE**) are equal-status modes, not a volume dial. Each changes the prompt policy and the output budget, the card shows which mode produced it, and the settings panel switches it. No mode collapses into `safe`.
- **Cache:** the rules and the voice samples form a byte-identical head, the conversation is appended instead of re-windowed every turn, and only the volatile tail (mode, situation, evidence) changes, so the provider's automatic prefix cache can hit on most of the prompt.
- **Automatic ACE:** one ACE suggestion after each completed turn. You can turn it off in the ACE settings.
- **Pause:** stops automatic suggestions; `✦ ACE` still works on demand.
- **Text size:** one slider in the settings panel drives `--dsh-fs-w` / `--dsh-fs-meta` / `--dsh-fs-x`. The value is stored in `chrome.storage.local` when the container exposes

plugins.description: DSH plugin that extracts long-term facts from completed turns into an appendable Markdown memory inbox.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-memory-feeder

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-memory-feeder.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-memory-feeder)

DSH 的记忆写回插件。每个完成的主会话轮次结束后，它把用户与助手的文本同步写入本地队列，再用该会话的模型抽取长期事实，追加到 Markdown 记忆库的候选区，等你核实后再合并。

v1 只写 `agents/dsh/inbox.md`，**不会**直接修改 `shared/`、`projects/` 或 `MEMORY.md`。

## 行为

- 只处理顶层会话（跳过 `origin: subagent`），只在 `turn/end` 且原因为 `completed` 时入队。
- 入队是同步追加 `.pending.jsonl`，所以 `dsh headless` 一次性运行退出前也不会丢。
- 抽取在插件启动后约 1.5 秒、新轮次入队后约 5 秒、失败后 15 秒重试。
- 每个完成轮次向 `agents/dsh/inbox.md` 追加一块，带来源会话、工作目录、模型、置信度和原始对话摘录；轮次内抽到的事实按 scope 合并成块。
- 已写过的候选记在 `.seen.json`，重复运行不会重复写；同一队列条目最多尝试 3 次。
- 抽取以用户亲口说的事实、计划、目标、偏好为主；助手的建议不会被改写成用户计划，助手长解释只在有可复用结论时提取。
- 入队前与写盘前清洗 `sk-*`、GitHub token、`Bearer`、私钥和 `key: value` 形式的凭据。
- 抽取器不读正式记忆，可能提出与已有条目重复的候选；合并时以正式条目为准。

## 安装

### 方式 A：从 npm 安装（web）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-memory-feeder
```

装完重启 DSH web，并硬刷新页面。

### 方式 B：从 GitHub 安装（web）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Ryan-G-Rolling/dsh-memory-feeder
```

装完重启 DSH web，并硬刷新页面。

默认记忆库是 `~/.dsh/memory`（Windows 为 `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\memory`），插件会自动创建候选区。要指向已有记忆库，在启动 DSH 的同一个 shell 里设置环境变量：

```powershell
# Windows PowerShell
$env:DSH_MEMORY_ROOT = 'D:\Projects\memory'
```

```sh
# bash / zsh
export DSH_MEMORY_ROOT="$HOME/memory"
```

`DSH_MEMORY_ROOT` 只在 patch 里没有显式 `memoryRoot` 时生效。headless 用的 profile 不一定是 `web`；桌面版宿主只读自己的 profile 层，这两种情况按方式 C 手动接。

### 方式 C：手动 patch（桌面版 / 自定义路径）

DSH 分两层：

- `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`：给 web 和 headless 用。
- `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`：给桌面版用。桌面宿主只读 profile 层，不读 home 层，所以桌面版必须单独 insert；桌面 profile 由 Electron 独占，不能用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop` 安装。

把下面的 insert 块追加到对应 patch 文件。`name` 用插件 `index.js` 的绝对路径（见 [cordis.patch.example.yml](cordis.patch.example.yml)）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-memory-feeder
      name: '<PLUGIN_DIR>/index.js'
      config:
        memoryRoot: '<MEMORY_ROOT>'
        inboxSubdir: agents/dsh
        debounceMs: 5000
        maxItems: 5
        minConfidence: 0.6
```

两处可以共用同一个队列和 `.seen.json`，不会重复写同一条记忆。改完桌面 patch 后重启桌面版。

> 同一个层不要装两次，否则同一轮会入队两次。

## 配置项

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `memoryRoot` | `DSH_MEMORY_ROOT` 或 `~/.dsh/memory` | 记忆库根目录 |
| `inboxSubdir` | `agents/dsh` | 候选区相对路径，写入其中的 `inbox.md` |
| `debounceMs` | `5000` | 新轮次入队后延迟多久抽取 |
| `startupDelayMs` | `1500` | 启动后处理遗留队列的延迟 |
| `retryDelayMs` | `15000` | 失败或队列未清空时的重试间隔 |
| `maxPerRun` | `5` | 每次最多处理几条队列记录 |
| `maxQueueAttempts` | `3` | 单条记录最多尝试次数 |
| `maxItems` | `5` | 每轮最多保留几条候选 |
| `minConfidence` | `0.6` | 低于该置信度的提取结果丢弃 |
| `minTurnChars` | `30` | 用户加助手文本低于该长度不入队 |
| `maxTranscriptChars` | `16000` | 入队文本上限，用户约占 40% |
| `maxSeenEntries` | `2000` | 去重哈希保留条数 |
| `provider` / `model` | 空 | 留空时用该会话 `request/header` 的路由 |
| `queuePath` / `seenPath` / `logPath` | 插件目录 | 队列、去重表和日志位置 |

路径都建议用绝对路径。Windows 下 YAML 单引号里的反斜杠不需要转义，写成正斜杠也可以。

## 本地测试

复制 [test.patch.example.yml](test.patch.example.yml)，替换其中的 `<PLUGIN_DIR>` 与 `<MEMORY_ROOT>`，然后：

```sh
dsh headless --patch "<PLUGIN_DIR>/test.patch.example.yml" "随便完成一轮对话"
```

测试 patch 把候选区指到 `agents/dsh/_feeder_test`。headless 通常在入队后立刻退出，异步抽取可能来不及跑；再执行一次同样的命令，启动时就会处理上一条队列记录。

跑完清理：

```sh
rm -rf "<MEMORY_ROOT>/agents/dsh/_feeder_test"
rm -f "<PLUGIN_DIR>/.pending.test.jsonl" "<PLUGIN_DIR>/.seen.test.json" "<PLUGIN_DIR>/.feeder.test.log"
```

## 日志与排错

- 日志同时写 stderr 和插件目录的 `.feeder.log`，前缀 `[dsh-memory-feeder]`；stderr 不污染 headless 的 stdout。
- 启动日志 `ready (memoryRoot=...)` 会打印实际使用的路径；路径不对时改 `memoryRoot` 或 `DSH_MEMORY_ROOT`。
- 入队日志是 `queued turn ...`；抽取成功是 `extracted N item(s)` 和 `appended ...`。
- 卡在 `skip turn: no provider/model` 时，在配置里显式指定 `provider` 和 `model`。

## 安全边界

- 队列和日志里会有对话原文，按敏感文件对待，不要提交到公开仓库。仓库自带的 `.gitignore` 已忽略这些文件。
- 不写 API key、token、密码、登录态；敏感信息只放环境变量。
- 写入前会清洗常见凭据格式，但清洗是兜底，不是保证。不要把密钥粘进对话。
- 记忆库如果同步到远端，`inbox.md` 里的候选和对话摘录也会一起同步，按需选择私有备份。

## 限制

- 只处理顶层会话；子代理的对话不入队。
- 依赖 DSH 的 `llm` 服务和会话 `request/header` 里的 provider/model。
- 候选不会自动合并、去重到正式条目；需要人或其他 agent 定期清理。
- 默认只写 `~/.dsh/memory`；要接入已有记忆库，必须显式配置路径。
- 在 Windows 的 DSH 桌面版、web 和 headless 上验证过；其他平台未实测。

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-music-request · 点歌台

[![CI](https://github.com/yeqiqiye/music-plugin/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/yeqiqiye/music-plugin/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

一套面板，两种形态：

| 形态 | 怎么用 | 适合 |
|---|---|---|
| **DSH 插件** | 挂进 DSH web profile，按 **Alt+T** 打开，跨平台搜歌并**在面板里播放** | 自己一边干活一边听 |
| **IIROSE 用户脚本** | 在 IIROSE 的「引用 JS 脚本文件链接」里粘一个链接，进房间后点歌 → **整间房都能听到** | 在蔷薇花园里当点歌台 |

IIROSE 版只需要一个 https 链接，**不需要装任何东西、不需要服务器**：→ [docs/iirose.md](docs/iirose.md)

---

## DSH 版

## 能力

| 平台 | 搜索 | 直接播放 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 网易云音乐 | ✅ | ✅ mp3 128k/320k | `fee=1`（版权锁/VIP）拿不到音频，会明确提示并给「打开」跳转 |
| QQ 音乐 | ✅ | ✅ m4a 128k（配 `QQ_COOKIE` 可放绿钻） | 酷狗已下线，用 QQ 音乐平替 |
| B 站 | ✅ | ✅ 视频（默认）/ 音频轨 | 视频走 html5 直链，客户端直连 CDN，不占中转流量 |

播放器：播/暂停、上一首/下一首、进度条拖动、音量、**听歌列表（顶栏「队列」）**；歌单支持**全部点歌**和**多选点歌**。

## 安装（DSH web profile）

```powershell
# 1. 构建客户端产物（只有改了 client/panel-ui.js 才需要）
node scripts/build.mjs

# 2. 挂进 profile
#    profile 目录：%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web
#    ① package.json 的 dependencies 加 "dsh-music-request": "file:<本目录绝对路径>"
#    ② package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 加 "dsh-music-request"
#    ③ 把本包复制/软链到 <profile>/node_modules/dsh-music-request

# 3. 重启该 profile
dsh --profile web
```

重启后页面里：按 **Alt+T** 开关面板（Esc 关闭）。

## 架构

```
host（Node 侧，lib/）                       client（浏览器侧，client/ + lib/client.js）
  index.mjs    注册 /music/api/* 路由          panel-ui.js  面板 UI（纯 DOM，无框架依赖）
  adapters.mjs 四个平台的搜索 + 归一化          client.js    构建产物：Alt+T、挂面板、同源 fetch
  playurl.mjs  「能不能播/播哪个地址」唯一判断
  proxy.mjs    音频代理（Range 透传 + 域名白名单）
  http.mjs     出站 fetch 的唯一实现
```

为什么必须有 host 半侧：浏览器直接请求这些平台会被 CORS 拦，音频 CDN 还会校验 Referer；
163 返回的播放地址是 `http://`，页面在 localhost/https 下会被混合内容拦。所以搜索与播放都走
同源路由，前端只跟 `/music/api/*` 说话。

## 安全边界

- `/music/api/stream` 是**域名白名单**代理（`.music.126.net` / `.kugou.com` / `.bilivideo.com` 等），
  不在白名单一律 403 —— 否则这个路由会变成任意外网中转。
- 登录只接受用户自己粘贴的 Cookie，存 `%DSH_HOME%/music-plugin/credentials.json`（0600）；
  完整 Cookie 永不回传前端、不写日志。
- 路由只监听本机 loopback（`dsh web` 默认 `127.0.0.1`）。**如果把 host 改成 `0.0.0.0`，
  这些路由没有额外鉴权，请自行加门禁。**

## 开发与自测

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs            # 构建 lib/client.js（DSH 版）
node scripts/build-iirose.mjs     # 构建 iirose/music-iirose.js（IIROSE 版）
npm run build:all                 # 两个一起构建
npm test                          # CI 跑的就是这一步：三套测试
node dev/try-adapters.mjs 周杰伦   # 四个平台搜索是否还通（上游随时可能变）
node dev/probe-playurl.mjs        # 播放地址是否还能拿到（容器/码率/Range）
node dev/smoke-client.mjs         # 假 DOM 跑真实 client.js：Alt+T、面板挂载、播放链路
node dev/panel-jsdom.mjs          # 真 DOM（需 npm i -D jsdom；没装会自跳过）
node dev/iirose-smoke.mjs         # 真 DOM 跑 IIROSE 版：点播两帧逐字段断言
node dev/server.mjs               # 本地起 3098，浏览器开 /selftest 看逐项自检
```

两个产物都是**提交进仓库**的（jsDelivr 只认仓库里的文件），所以改完源码必须重新构建；
CI 会用 `git diff --exit-code` 抓「改了源码忘构建」。

## IIROSE 版

在 IIROSE 里：设置 →「引用 JS 脚本文件链接」→ 粘一行（多个脚本一行一个）：

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net.cn/gh/yeqiqiye/music-plugin@v0.2.0/iirose/music-iirose.js
```

刷新页面，进「音乐分享 / 视频分享」属性的房间，按 **Alt+T**（或点右下角 ♪）打开面板，
搜歌点 ▶ —— 歌会进房间歌单，所有人都听得到。结果多的时候底部有「上一页 / 下一页」。

想连**酷狗 / B 站**：这两个平台浏览器直连被 CORS/反爬挡住，需要一个只中转元数据的小服务。
仓库里给了现成的 [`relay/worker.js`](relay/worker.js)（Cloudflare Worker，粘上去就能用），
配好后 `localStorage.setItem('mk_iirose_relay', 'https://你的地址')` 刷新即多两个 tab。

细节、房间要求、失败兜底、换接口基址 → [docs/iirose.md](docs/iirose.md)

## 已知问题

- 网易云 `fee=1` 的歌**无法**直接播放（返回 `code=-110`），这是上游版权锁，不是 bug。
- QQ 音乐只能搜索 + 跳转。
- 播放地址有时效签名：`playurl.mjs` 内存缓存 5 分钟，过期会自动重新解析。
- 面板与 `shell.overlay` 插槽的耦合很弱（面板是 `document.body` 直属节点），
  插槽注册失败也不会影响 Alt+T。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 yeqiqiye

plugins.description: Evaluation guard for DSH: workspace-only filesystem, no network/subagents, wall-clock limits, and tank task installation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-eval-guard · 评测守护

在 DSH 中启用后，约束**所有用户主对话**：

- 只能读写会话工作区；工作区外（包括 /tmp）不可访问。
- 禁止联网、子代理、Agent Team/跨 agent 通信、读取其它工作区。
- 工具黑名单可配置；未知工具默认放行，但 DSH 内置与 dsh-ops 的工具会做参数路径审计。

## 时间限制

- 每条用户消息发送时，用**当时的** timeLimitEnabled 和 timeLimitMinutes 为本会话创建或清除 deadline。
- 开启限时时：deadline = 当前时刻 + 当时的分钟数；之后修改分钟数、选择任务、关闭或重新打开限时，都**不会**改动已存在的 deadline。
- 关闭限时后再次给已有 deadline 的会话发送消息，会清空该会话自己的 deadline；其它会话不受影响。
- 重新打开限时后，已有会话不会自动恢复 deadline；下一次用户消息才会重新计时。
- 每个会话独立计时；可以同时运行多个不同时长、有的开启限时有的不开启的会话。
- deadline 到点只终止对应会话及其子代理/后台任务，不影响其它会话。
- 关闭「评测守护」总开关会清空全部 deadline 并停止约束；总开关与单轮限时开关是两套状态。

设置页选择任务时会自动把「最长时长 + 限时开关」写成该任务默认值并立即显示，用户可以随后手动修改：

| 任务类型 | 默认限时 |
|---|---|
| 原 5 个 meow-ai-arena 任务 | 90 分钟，默认打开 |
| Commit0 单库 | 480 分钟，默认关闭 |
| SWE-Bench Pro 单任务 | 1440 分钟，默认关闭 |
| FeatureBench 单 feature | 1440 分钟，默认关闭 |
| Neural-CPP 纯 C++ 张量后端 | 1440 分钟，默认关闭 |

## 任务与安装

设置页可安装九个任务包：

- 原 5 个比赛任务：坦克大战、仓储调度、圈地、炸弹人、夺旗。
- 3 个长时单任务：Commit0 单库实现、SWE-Bench Pro 单任务、FeatureBench 单 feature。
- 1 个纯 C++ 项目：Neural-CPP 张量运算与反向传播后端。

Neural-CPP 安装时自动把 workspace.zip 解压到工作区根目录，并在完成后移除 setup.sh；agent 从根目录的 CMakeLists.txt 开始。工作区只包含 TASK.md、CMakeLists.txt 和 include/nn/nn.hpp；实现在 src/ 中从零完成，纯 C++17，无 Python/OpenCL/第三方库。

评测器同时兼容旧安装留下的嵌套布局：若根目录没有 CMakeLists.txt，会自动改用 workspace/CMakeLists.txt，避免已经产出的工作区无法评测。

评测时在临时目录独立构建，然后从 assets/neural-cpp/hidden/ 注入 C++ 测试源码；测试数据由固定种子在进程内生成，不依赖或复制外部数据文件。

结果返回 coreAccuracy（核心 C++ 测试通过率）、matrixAccuracy、逐类型 metrics（f32/int128/MXFP4 的矩阵与反向准确率、平均绝对误差、fwd/bwd 毫秒、fwd/bwd GFLOP/s）、speedGflops，以及按矩阵吞吐计算的 speedGeomeanGflops 和 matrixSizes（f32/i128/MXFP4 均为 256×256×256）。确定性项目使用 4 组独立输入取平均；MXFP4 RNE 和随机舍入分开统计，随机舍入使用 2 组输入×每组 1024 次采样，逐元素比较参考均值/标准差和候选均值/标准差，按 3σ 和 0.1–10× 标准差规则统计正确率。参考值由测试侧独立标量实现先算完，再调用候选实现，参考计算不计入候选耗时。隐藏测试不在工作区，agent 无法读取。开发要求线程数最多 4，评测阶段使用全部逻辑 CPU。

原 5 个任务直接放入打包好的 workspace.zip。后 3 个任务在安装时由 host 侧 setup 脚本按固定 commit clone 仓库、创建 .venv 并安装依赖；安装完成后会清理 `.git`、`setup.sh`、`remove.patch`、`spec.pdf.bz2` 等安装产物，工作区只保留任务本身素材。Commit0 的 `pytest.ini` 会去掉 coverage 参数，保证默认测试命令在沙箱内可运行。agent 运行时仍然禁网，使用工作区内的 .venv 跑测试；agent 可以自行 `git init` 或写自己的脚本。

安装是后台任务：

- 可分别选择 clone 远端、pip 镜像、Git 代理和 pip 代理。
- 进度和日志持久化在 $DSH_HOME/eval-guard/jobs/<job-id>/。
- 离开设置页不会停止；重新进入继续显示；可以取消。
- 安装成功后显示提示词，可点「填入新会话」。

### 已验证的 Git 远端

只有验证过包含任务固定 commit 的远端才会显示在对应任务下：

- Commit0 · tinydb：GitHub。
- SWE-Bench Pro · ansible：GitHub、Gitee。
- FeatureBench · seaborn：GitHub、Gitee、GitCode。

Gitee/GitCode 都使用 git fetch --depth 1 origin <任务 commit> 验证。GitLab 和 ghfast 未通过验证，已移除。另保留「自定义 URL」。

### pip 镜像

提供 PyPI、清华 TUNA、阿里云、腾讯云、北外、上海交大，并保留自定义地址。

### 两个独立代理

- Git 代理：只用于 git clone/fetch。
- pip 代理：只用于 pip install。

地址可以写成 127.0.0.1:7897，会自动补 http:// 前缀。留空会清掉继承来的同名代理变量，不误用宿主机代理。

## 单工作区评测

设置页安装/评测共用一组任务和工作区选择；「评测当前工作区」只评测一个结果，不生成排行。

插件 eval/ 目录内置全部 9 个任务的单结果评测脚本：

- Commit0：单元测试通过率。
- SWE-Bench Pro / FeatureBench：隐藏 F2P/P2P 测试；全部通过才 resolved，同时返回 passRate。
- Neural-CPP：独立编译隐藏 C++ 测试，返回 accuracy 与 matmul speedGflops；数据在测试进程内按固定种子生成。
- Tank / Warehouse / Land / Bomberman / CTF：运行官方引擎/裁判，只返回当前工作区候选者结果，不生成排名。

评测也是后台任务，日志和结果实时显示，持久化在 jobs 目录。

## 任务来源

原 5 个任务来自 **meow-ai-arena**（MIT License，commit 6bd738b，2026-10-16）：

- 第 1 集 · 圈地：<https://github.com/chen-006/meow-ai-arena/tree/main/land>，素材 land/workspace/
- 第 2 集 · 炸弹人：<https://github.com/chen-006/meow-ai-arena/tree/main/bomberman>，素材 bomberman/workspace/
- 第 3 集 · 夺旗：<https://github.com/chen-006/meow-ai-arena/tree/main/ctf>，素材 ctf/workspace/
- 第 5 集 · 仓储调度：<https://github.com/chen-006/meow-ai-arena/tree/main/warehouse>，素材 warehouse/workspace/ 第 1 轮主程包，改编为单人单次 90 分钟
- 第 6 集 · 坦克大战：<https://github.com/chen-006/meow-ai-arena/tree/main/tank>，素材 tank/workspace/

仓库：<https://github.com/chen-006/meow-ai-arena>

长时单任务来源：

- Commit0 单库实现：<https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.01769>，数据集 <https://huggingface.co/datasets/wentingzhao/commit0_combined>，实例 commit-0/tinydb
- SWE-Bench Pro 单任务：<https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.16941>，数据集 <https://huggingface.co/datasets/ScaleAI/SWE-bench_Pro>，实例 ansible vars
- FeatureBench 单 feature：<https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10975>，数据集 <https://huggingface.co/datasets/LiberCoders/FeatureBench>，实例 seaborn regression

### 远端验证记录

- msiemens/tinydb @ ed761a72：GitHub 通过；Gitee mirrors/tinydb、GitCode gh_mirrors/ti/tinydb、GitLab 均无法 fetch 该 commit，未加入。
- ansible/ansible @ f7234968：GitHub、Gitee mirrors/ansible 通过；GitCode、GitLab 未通过，未加入。
- mwaskom/seaborn @ 7001ebe7：GitHub、Gitee mirrors/seaborn、GitCode gh_mirrors/se/seaborn 通过；GitLab 未通过，未加入。

## 打包适配

本插件打包的 Linux 版 workspace.zip 在原素材基础上做了适配：把 baseline.cpp 编译为 Linux ELF 可执行文件并移出源码，文件名改为 baseline（不带 .exe）；把 clock.py 改为单次 90 分钟版本；README.md 中对应的 baseline 示例同步改名。规则、引擎、本地裁判、模板等其余文件保持原样。安装任务时只把 workspace.zip 放入工作区，不再散装解压。

仓储调度任务包同样只放 workspace.zip；包内 TASK.md 已改写成单人单次 90 分钟版本，保留了原 baseline/、src/、workloads/ 和 tools/。

## 构建

~~~bash
node_modules/.bin/tsdown
node scripts/build-native.mjs
~~~

## 安装到当前 DSH profile

~~~bash
scripts/install.sh web
# 如果脚本找不到 dsh 命令：
DSH_CHECKOUT=/path/to/deepseek-harness scripts/install.sh web
# 然后重启 dsh web
~~~

## 依赖

- Linux + unprivileged user namespaces
- bubblewrap (bwrap)
- gcc（构建 native supervisor 时）
- unzip（安装任务素材时）
- Python 3（长任务 setup 与评测）

## 已知边界

- 只支持 Linux。
- seccomp 用户通知的路径检查与 open 之间存在极小的 TOCTOU 窗口；bwrap 只读/无网络挂载是第二层内核边界。
- 进程审计只覆盖被拦截的文件/网络 syscall；正常 syscall 不记录。
- 设置页使用内联样式，不依赖额外 CSS 构建链。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 用量统计插件：侧边栏今日用量卡片、当前对话 token 数、按供应商与模型的明细、账户余额与套餐额度、余量提醒、历史用量补录。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-usage-stat · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 用量统计、账户余额与套餐监控插件 [English](README.en.md) | 中文

   

给 DSH Web GUI 与桌面客户端的 Token 用量台账、账户余额与编程套餐监控
侧边栏用量卡 · 本次对话明细 · 时间范围驱动的用量页 · 余额与套餐 · 余量提醒 · 历史补录

它把每一次模型调用的 token 用量记成一份按「本地日期 / 供应商 / 模型」分桶的账本，再把同一份数据放在三个地方显示：侧边栏左下角的用量卡、输入框下方那枚「本次对话」胶囊、设置里的「用量统计」页。除了用量，它还会查询供应商的账户余额与编程套餐剩余额度，并在余量偏低时标出提醒。 数据只有两个来源：DSH 自己的会话事件（用量）和供应商自己的接口（余额与套餐）。余额与套餐**不做任何本地估算** —— 查不到就写明原因，不猜一个数字出来。 ## 界面 > 下面是 `tools/preview.mjs` 用**插件自己的组件**渲染出来的截图，不是应用截图：把样式表逐字注入，套在一个设置对话框外壳的替身里，颜色取自正在运行的 DSH 主题变量。主题色跟随皮肤变化，这里是原生主题。 | 位置 | 形态 | |---|---| | 侧边栏左下角 | 折叠时一行「今日用量 + 总量」，点开列出各供应商与模型；余量偏低时在对应供应商前点一个红点 | | 输入框下方 | 一枚「本次对话 N tokens」胶囊，点开是这段对话自己的分供应商、分模型明细 | | 设置 → 用量统计 | 四个标签页：用量、金额、账户、设置 |

        

点开可看原尺寸

## 功能 - **用量页**：一排等宽分栏的合计（总 tokens / 输入 / 输出 / 缓存读 / 调用次数，缓存写只在窗口内真的出现过时才占一格）、按供应商与模型的明细、以及覆盖整个所选窗口的每日柱状图。顶部可切换统计范围：今天、近 7 天、近 30 天、全部，或自选起止日期。所有卡片都跟随所选范围，供应商占比条全页共用一个刻度。 - **账户页**：每个供应商的账户余额与套餐窗口合在一处 —— 余额按币种显示，套餐显示 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月窗口的已用百分比与重置时间。查不到数据的供应商折叠在卡片最下面，并写明原因（未配置 API Key、已用账号登录、非官方地址、该供应商没有提供这项数据）。 - **金额页**：把所选窗口的 token 按价目表折算成金额，范围可以选全部、某个供应商、或某个供应商下的某个模型；单日窗口还会按小时折算。没有价格的模型不会被算成 0，而是单独列出来告诉你有多少 token 没计入。 - **设置页**：用量刷新间隔、账户查询开关与间隔、余量提醒阈值、价目表，以及底部的版本号与历史补录状态。 - **余量提醒**：给余额和三个套餐窗口各设一个阈值，低于阈值时在对应供应商旁点一个红点（左下角卡片与账户页都有）。阈值填 0 表示那一项不提醒。判定发生在读取时，所以改完立刻生效。 - **历史补录**：插件只记录它运行期间的用量。首次启用时会自动把 DSH 已经保存在磁盘上的过往会话补进来；中间关过插件的话，可以在设置页手动再补一次。补录按调用发生的那一天入账，不会算成今天。 ### 柱状图的纵轴 纵轴是**相对的**：所选窗口里用量最重的那天就是满格。绝对刻度会把安静的一周压成一条看不见的线，而相对刻度让你一眼看出形状；卡片右上角会写出这个锚点（例如「最高 33.3M（10-17）」），把鼠标停在柱子上能看到当天的总量与调用次数。 选中「今天」或某个具体日期时，这张图换成**每小时**：固定 24 列，空的小时不画柱子（没有记录和用量为零是两回事），峰值同样写在卡片右上角。多日窗口仍然是按天。 ### 金额是怎么算的 按**价目表的标准价**折算，不含任何折扣、套餐或中转站的加价 —— 它是一个参考值，不是账单。内置了 DeepSeek 官方两档模型的价格，其余模型可以在设置页里按「每百万 token 的输入、输出、缓存读、缓存写」自己添一行。 内置价是官方的**空闲时段**价；DeepSeek 在北京时间工作日 9:00-12:00、14:00-18:00 按两倍计费，周末与中国法定节假日全天按空闲价。插件按每次调用发生的时刻判断，所以同一个窗口里的高峰时段和空闲时段各按各的价算。 价格可以**带生效日期**：涨价就再加一行、填上新价生效的那天，旧价仍然管着它生效的那段历史。生效日期留空表示从最早算起。 改价格会**立刻改变它生效范围内所有已记录调用**的金额：金额是读取时按当前价目表算出来的，不写进账本，所以纠正一个价格就纠正了那段历史，而不是只影响以后。 内置价目表和节假日表会**自动更新**：每天读一次 DeepSeek 官方定价页，每月读一次节假日表，结果缓存在本机。读不到、或者页面改了版式认不出来，就继续用上一次拿到的（从没拿到过就用随插件内置的那份），不会因此把金额算错。 缓存写没有单独给价时按输入价计。没有价格的模型不参与合计，只报告「另有 N 个模型未定价，X tokens 未计入」—— 把未知价格当成 0 会让合计看起来像免费的，那比不给数字更糟。 ## 安装 要求 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高，Web GUI 与官方桌面客户端都可以。 从 GitHub 安装： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+https://github.com/SereneJi/dsh-usage-stat.git ``` 从本地克隆安装（源码即产物，改完刷新页面就生效，适合自己改）： ```bash git clone https://github.com/SereneJi/dsh-usage-stat.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:./dsh-usage-stat ``` `--profile` 填你在用的 profile 名（桌面客户端是 `desktop`，`dsh web` 一般是 `web`）。 宿主端改动需要重启一次 DSH；此后的界面改动刷新页面即可。设置入口在 **设置 → 用量统计**。 卸载： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-usage-stat ``` ## 配置 设置页里的每一项都对应 `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/config.json` 里的一个键（`$DSH_HOME` 默认是 `~/.dsh`）。 | 键 | 默认 | 含义 | | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；关掉后不记账、不探测、界面消失 | | `pollIntervalSec` | `60` | 界面刷新用量的间隔（5–600 秒） | | `probeEnabled` | `true` | 是否查询供应商余额与套餐 | | `probeIntervalSec` | `300` | 余额与套餐的查询间隔（60–3600 秒） | | `alertEnabled` | `true` | 余量提醒总开关 | | `alertBalanceBelow` | `0` | 余额低于这个金额时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `alertWindow5h` | `0` | 5 小时窗口剩余低于这个百分比时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `alertWindowWeek` | `0` | 本周窗口剩余低于这个百分比时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `alertWindowMonth` | `0` | 本月窗口剩余低于这个百分比时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `prices` | DeepSeek 官方两档（空闲价） | 价目表；键是模型名，值是每百万 token 的 `input` / `output` / `cacheRead` / `cacheWrite`（CNY）。同一个模型可以给多行，每行带一个 `from` 生效日期 | 价目表也可以直接写在配置文件里，格式与设置页里的文本一致： ```json "prices": { "deepseek-flash": { "input": 2, "output": 8, "cacheRead": 0.04, "cacheWrite": 2 } } ``` `deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`deepseek-v4-flash` 这类带版本或后缀的名字会自动归到内置的 `deepseek-flash` 一行，所以官方改小版本号不会让价格突然消失。 记账是本地且廉价的，查询供应商要出门、可能被限流，所以两者有各自独立的开关和周期：关掉 `probeEnabled` 之后用量照常统计，只是余额与套餐不再刷新。 提醒判定用的是「**低于**」：余额刚好等于阈值、或窗口刚好还剩阈值那么多，都**不算**命中。提醒也只在真的有数字可读时出现 —— 没有凭据、查不到余额、窗口没有百分比的供应商不会被点红点。 超出范围的值会被夹到边界，不认识的键会被忽略，手改文件不会把插件弄进界面表达不出的状态。 ## 数据放在哪 | 路径 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/usage.json` | 用量账本 | | `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/providers.json` | 余额与套餐快照 | | `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/upstream.json` | 抓到的价目表与节假日表（抓不到就用内置的） | | `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/config.json` | 配置 | 账本**刻意不设时间与体积上限**。一天一个日期桶在 1 KB 量级，一年也就几百 KB，而任何「只保留 N 天」「超过 N KB 就删」的规则都只会在某一天悄悄丢掉你本来看得到的历史。唯一剩下的上限是会话行的条数（5000），那是防止文件被跑坏的兜底，不是预算。 供应商的 API Key 由 DSH 自己的凭据服务保管，只被宿主端读取，**不会进入浏览器**。 ## 已知限制 - **历史补录只能补回 DSH 日志还在的会话**：日志被删掉的、或在别的工作区里已经清掉的，补不回来。没有序号的事件会被跳过 —— 一个无法与已计过的调用区分开的事件，宁可漏记也不重复计数。补录是一次性的书签，不是持续订阅：日志在插件运行期间仍在增长，那部分由实时事件负责。 - **余额与套餐只覆盖已知端点的供应商**（余额 9 条路由、套餐 8 条）。其余供应商会写「该供应商没有提供这项数据」，不会用本地 token 数折算成钱。 - **余额需要能读到的 API Key**。用账号登录的供应商（例如桌面端的 DeepSeek 账号）不一定提供开放平台的余额接口，界面会如实说明。 - **金额是标准价折算，不是账单**：不含折扣、套餐与中转站的加价。内置价是官方**空闲时段**价，工作日 9:00-12:00 与 14:00-18:00 按两倍计；峰谷判定用**本机时区**，法定节假日表来自公开日历，国务院尚未公布的年份按普通工作日算。缓存写没有单独给价时按 0 计，没有价格的模型只报告、不计入合计。 - **图表最多回溯 366 天**：`全部` 或跨年窗口里，每日柱状图只画最近 366 天，轴上的日期只到月-日，所以更早的部分既看不到也不显示。 - **余量提醒是界面上的标记，不是系统通知**：它只出现在左下角卡片与账户页，不会弹窗、不发声。 - **「本次对话」的分供应商明细只对启用之后的对话有效**：更早的对话只留下总量，这时面板会写明「只有总量记录」，而不是把总量算到某个供应商头上。 - **界面文案是插件自带的 zh/en 两套**，按浏览器语言选一次，不跟随 DSH 设置里切换语言。 - 侧边栏卡片依赖 DSH 侧边栏的 DOM 结构，落位失败会退化成「追加到侧边栏底部」，不会崩 —— 这是 DOM 注入的固有代价。 ## 许可证与来源 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 界面布局的灵感来自 [`@linxin666/dsh-usage`](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web)（Apache-2.0）。 ## 开发 面向维护者的内容 —— 数据来源与折叠语义、HTTP 接口、代码结构、设计取舍、测试与预览台、回退与升级路径 —— 都在 [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: Agent tools and a loopback REST API for DSH session housekeeping: list, move across workspaces, delete with backup, tag, archive and unarchive.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-manager

Agent tools and a loopback REST API for DSH session housekeeping — list, move across workspaces, delete with an optional backup, tag, archive and unarchive.

DSH's own GUI covers only part of this surface (it can archive, but not unarchive; it has no tags; cross-workspace moves need a restart). This plugin puts the whole surface on two rails that share one implementation:

- **Agent tools** — six tools the model can call directly.
- **Loopback REST API** — the same six operations over HTTP, so a browser plugin can drive them without an IPC bridge. [`dsh-session-tree`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-tree) uses this to render tags, drag-and-drop and the archive menu in the sidebar.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.2` (developed and tested against it) |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `~4.0.5` |
| Runtime | Node.js 22+ (ships with the DSH desktop runtime) |

Earlier DSH releases are untested. The plugin reads `workspaceRegistry`, `sessionPersistence`, `storageDomain` and `webServer`; a release that renames or removes any of those will make the corresponding feature fail soft (logged as a warning) rather than crash the host.

## Install

```bash
# from git (recommended)
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:minhaoli/dsh-session-manager

# or from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-manager
```

`<your-profile>` is the profile you actually boot — `desktop` for the Electron app, `web` / `headless` / `node` for the CLI modes. The `desktop` profile is managed by the Electron app and refuses `dsh` CLI writes while the app is running; install into it from the app's own plugin manager, or close the app first.

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` also appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` and the loader mounts it on the next start. If you installed by hand, add the row yourself:

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: session-manager
      name: 'dsh-session-manager'
```

## Agent tools

All six take JSON arguments and return `{ ok: true, ... }` or `{ ok: false, error }`.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `session_list` | Enumerate persisted sessions with workspace, archive state, tags and title. Filters: `workspaceId`, `path`, `archived`, `tag`. |
| `session_move` | Move sessions across workspaces. Rewrites the log header `cwd` and renames the directory on disk, then updates the registry live — the GUI reflects it without a restart. |
| `session_delete` | Permanently delete sessions and their log directories. Pass `backupDir` to copy each directory first. |
| `session_tag` | `set` / `add` / `remove` / `clear` / `drop` / `list` tags. Stored in `~/.dsh/session-tags.json`. |
| `session_archive` | Hide a session from every grouping surface; log and workspace slot preserved. Idempotent. |
| `session_unarchive` | Restore an archived session to its original position — the direction the GUI is missing. |

Live sessions (the conversation the model is currently running in) are refused by `session_move` and `session_delete`.

## REST API

Registered only when the `webServer` service is present (the `web` and `desktop` modes). Every handler funnels through the corresponding tool's `execute`, so both surfaces behave identically.

Every request is fenced by `isLoopbackRequest(req)` — a non-loopback peer gets `403 {"error":"forbidden: loopback-only"}`. There is no token; the fence is the transport, not a credential. Do not expose the DSH web server beyond localhost while this plugin is mounted.

| Method | Path | Body / query |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions` | — |
| `GET` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/tags` | — |
| `PUT` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/tags` | `{ "sessionId": "...", "tags": ["a","b"] }` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/tags` | `{ "tags": ["a"] }` — drops those tags from every session |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/move` | `{ "sessionIds": [...], "targetWorkspaceId": "..." }` or `{ ..., "targetPath": "...", "createIfMissing": true }` |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/delete` | `{ "sessionIds": [...], "backupDir": "..." }` (`backupDir` optional) |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/archive` | `{ "sessionId": "..." }` |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/unarchive` | `{ "sessionId": "..." }` |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/projcache/warm` | — (diagnostics: returns the title warm-up report) |

Status codes: `200` when the tool returned `ok: true`, `400` for a business failure or a malformed body, `403` off-loopback, `405` wrong method, `500` unexpected throw.

Request bodies are capped at 1 MB and must be JSON objects.

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/dsh-session-manager/tags
curl -s -X PUT http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/dsh-session-manager/tags \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"sessionId":"abc123","tags":["research","todo"]}'
```

## Behaviour worth knowing

**Moves keep three things in sync.** The physical move (zstd header rewrite plus directory rename) is followed by a registry header re-index and the public `attachSession` / `detachSession` calls, and the projection cache's `identity.cwd` is updated through the storage-domain table handle. Skipping any of the three leaves the GUI showing a stale path.

**Titles are pre-warmed at startup.** `session.list` carries no title for a cold session; the durable title lives in the projection-cache checkpoint, which is only written when a session was attached in some process. After a restart every unopened session is cold and the sidebar falls back to the directory basename. 800 ms after mount the plugin walks persisted sessions lacking a title row and calls the official `coldSnapshot(meta, inheritedEventCount, events)` to write the checkpoint back.

The tail probe that validates an existing title row is **off** (`WARM_TAIL_PROBE = false` in `lib/index.js`). With it on, every start re-read the log tail of all sessions — the dominant cost of a slow sidebar after a restart, at roughly 620 sessions. The trade-off: a rename that happened during a projection-cache write failure window is no longer corrected at startup; the official cold-read ladder still heals it when the session is opened. Set the constant to `true` to restore the old behaviour.

**Archive goes through the registry.** Archiving funnels through `archiveSession()` — the same add-only API the GUI uses. The plugin never rewrites the archive set except on an explicit delete or unarchive, and even then it goes through the registry's public `enqueueOperation` / `setState` write chain so the registry's cached state stays coherent.

**Zero imports by design.** `lib/index.js` uses only `node:` builtins. The file plugin is loaded by native dynamic import, so a bare specifier would have to resolve from the profile's `node_modules`; the builtin-only rule keeps it loadable as a standalone file plugin (the same shape as `zen-useragent.js`).

## Companion plugins

- [`dsh-session-tree`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-tree) — the sidebar UI (tags, grouping, drag-to-move, delete) that consumes this REST API. It replaces the official `ui-workspace` bundle, so disable that row when both are installed.
- [`dsh-session-query-vector`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-query-vector) — semantic session search backend.
- [`dsh-session-search`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-search) — in-conversation find bar.
- [`dsh-ui-reload`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-ui-reload) — one-click frontend reload button.

plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goe

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: DSH bundle plugin: author Python tools in the Web UI or through agent tools, register them as first-class DSH tools, gate dangerous runs through built-in approval, group tools into packs.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 自定义工具工作室（dsh-custom-tool-studio）

在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）里**用 Python 写工具，保存即生效**。

两条入口都能用：

- **网页**：左侧导航「自定义工具」→ 新建 / 编辑 / 测试 / 删除 / 启停；
- **对话**：直接让模型调用内置的 `custom_tool_manage` 工具。

保存后的工具会立刻注册成真正的 DSH 工具（不需要重启 DSH），模型下一轮就能调用。所有数据只存在本机 `%DSH_HOME%\custom-tools`，不会上传。

## 1. 这个插件做什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 创建工具 | 起一个**模型可见的工具名**，写描述、参数 JSON Schema、Python 代码 |
| 即时注册 | 保存/启用/改名/删除后，host 立即对账并注册或注销，无需重启 DSH |
| 试运行 | 页面「测试」或 AI 的 `custom_tool_manage` → `action="test"`，直接传参数跑一次 |
| 危险工具 | 标记后**每次执行前**都走 DSH 内置审批，和内置的自动审查兼容 |
| 工具包 | 把几个工具归到一个有名称、有描述的分组里，一键启停整包；工具仍各自注册 |
| AI 主动解锁 | 开启后每个对话只看到管理/解锁两个工具，AI 解锁工具包后才出现包内工具；支持「始终解锁」与未分组工具单独解锁 |
| 统一存储 | 所有工具存在一个 `tools.json`，可整体备份、迁移、删除 |
| 一键恢复 | `restore.ps1` 把插件从 profile 里干净卸载，可选清空工具数据 |

不是 Skill、不是 MCP：工具是**同进程注册的真正 DSH 工具**，执行时由 host 启动本机 Python 进程运行你的脚本。

## 2. 界面入口

安装并重启 DSH 后，左侧导航栏会出现「自定义工具」（与「插件」「插件市场」「自动化任务」「技能中心」同一排）。点进去是工具列表页：

- 每行显示工具名（等宽字体）、标题、一句话描述，以及 `Python`、`危险`、`已禁用` 徽标；
- 列表按**工具包分组**：每个包一张卡片，卡片头是包名、包描述、`N 个工具 · 启用 M`，右侧是整包开关和 `编辑`/`删除`；没有归包的工具放在最后一张「未分组工具」卡片里；
- 每行右侧：`测试`、`编辑`、`删除`，以及该工具自己的启用/停用开关；
- 顶部按钮：`设置`、`刷新`、`新建工具包`、`新建工具`。`新建工具` 打开编辑对话框：名称、标题、描述、所属工具包、参数 JSON Schema、Python 代码、危险工具开关、启用开关；
- 没有工具也没有工具包时显示空状态和 `def run(args): ...` 约定；
- 如果 host 探测不到 Python，页面顶部会显示「未检测到 Python，创建的工具无法执行」的警告条，并带上具体原因。

「测试」对话框里填 `args` JSON（就是传给 `run(args)` 的对象），点「运行」后显示成功/失败、结果、stdout、stderr 和耗时。**测试失败不会弄坏已保存的工具**。

---

## 3. Python 工具约定

### 3.1 最小例子

```python
def run(args):
    text = args["text"]
    return {
        "chars": len(text),
        "upper": text.upper(),
    }
```

- 脚本必须定义 **`def run(args):`**（页面和 AI 侧都会校验代码里有没有这个入口）；
- `args` 是模型按**参数 JSON Schema** 传进来的参数对象（普通 Python `dict`）；
- **返回值**必须是可 JSON 序列化的值（`dict` / `list` / `str` / 数字 / `bool` / `None`）。host 会把它 `json.dumps(..., ensure_ascii=False)` 后作为工具结果给模型看；
- 返回值是**结果通道**，`print()` 是**日志通道**，两者互不干扰：
  - `print()` / `sys.stdout` 的内容作为 `stdout` 展示（最多保留末尾 8,000 字符）；
  - 脚本写到 `sys.stderr` 的内容进 `stderr`；抛出的异常被抓成 `error`（含 traceback），不会混进 `stderr`；
  - 结果 JSON 超过 20,000 字符会被截断。
- 脚本在独立 Python 进程里执行，工作目录是 DSH 进程的当前目录；可以用 Python 标准库，第三方库需要装在那个解释器里；
- 默认超时 **60 秒**，超时或取消会终止进程。可用环境变量 `DSH_CUSTOM_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS` 调整（毫秒），改完重启 DSH；
- 每次执行都会在 `runs\` 下建一个临时目录（`tool.py`、`args.json`、`result.json`、`stdout.txt`、`stderr.txt`），只保留最新 **30** 个；
- 解释器探测顺序：`DSH_CUSTOM_TOOL_PYTHON`（可指定完整路径）→ `python` → `python3` → `py -3`。

### 3.2 参数 JSON Schema 怎么填

参数根节点必须是 JSON **对象**。常用写法：

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "text": { "type": "string", "description": "要统计的文本" },
    "limit": { "type": "integer", "description": "最多返回几行" }
  },
  "required": ["text"]
}
```

- `description` 写给模型看，说明每个参数的含义；
- `required` 里列出必填参数；
- 没有参数就填 `{"type": "object", "properties": {}}`；
- 非法 JSON 或非对象会被 host 容忍并退化成「无参数」，但那样模型就传不进参数了——以页面「测试」的结果为准。

### 3.3 名称与描述

- 工具名规则：`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,47}$`（小写字母开头，只含小写字母/数字/下划线，长度 2–48）；
- `run_code` 是 DSH 保留名，不能使用；
- 不能和内置工具、其它插件已经注册的工具重名（例如 `read_file`），冲突时保存会报「已被现有工具占用」；
- `description` 是**模型选工具的主要依据**，写清「做什么 / 什么时候用 / 返回什么」；
- 标题（`title`）只给人看，可以写中文；不填时默认等于工具名。

## 4. 危险工具与内置审批 / 自动审查

- 编辑对话框里的「危险工具」开关，或 AI 侧 `dangerous: true`，会把工具标记为危险；
- 标为危险后，模型**每一次调用**它都会先产生一个 `ask` 审批决定，由 DSH 内置审批界面问你「是否运行危险自定义工具 xxx？」，点拒绝就不会执行；AI 通过 `custom_tool_manage` 的 `action="test"` 试跑危险工具同样要审批；
- 页面上的「测试」按钮是你本人直接点的一次运行，直接执行、不弹审批（否则等于自己审批自己）；
- 这与 desktop profile 默认加载的内置**自动审查**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review`）兼容：自动审查策略接管 `ask` 的时候同样按它的判断走，不需要额外配置；
- 非危险工具**不会**弹审批；
- 建议把会写文件、删文件、执行系统命令、访问网络、读取敏感目录的工具都标成危险。

### 4.1 管理操作审批（顶部「设置」）

除「危险工具执行」之外，还可以让 AI 的**管理操作**也要你确认：

| 开关 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| 创建工具需要审批 | 关 | AI 用 `custom_tool_manage` 的 `create` 新建工具时先弹审批 |
| 修改工具需要审批 | 关 | AI 用 `update` 改名称/描述/参数/代码/危险与启用状态时先弹审批 |
| 删除工具需要审批 | **开** | AI 用 `delete` 删除工具时先弹审批（删除不可恢复，所以默认开） |

工具包的操作复用同样三个开关：

| AI action | 走哪个开关 |
|---|---|
| `pack_create` | 创建工具需要审批 |
| `pack_update`（改描述/改成员/改名） | 修改工具需要审批 |
| `pack_delete` | 删除工具需要审批 |
| `pack_set_enabled` | 不拦（和 `set_enabled` 一样，只是批量改启用状态） |

- 三个开关存在 `%DSH_HOME%\custom-tools\settings.json`，点「保存设置」写入；
- 只拦截 **AI 侧** 的 `custom_tool_manage`；你在页面上点按钮 / 用表单操作不会被自己拦；
- `test`（试跑）不在三个开关里：它按「危险工具」规则单独判定；
- 「危险工具执行审批」不受这里影响，始终生效。

> 危险开关只是「每次都问」，不是沙箱。脚本仍以当前用户权限运行，写代码时要自己注意边界。

## 5. 工具包（把几个工具放在一起）

工具包（pack）是**分组**，不是新的工具类型：

- 一个包有**名称**（1–48 字符，可写中文）和**描述**；
- 包里的工具仍然是**各自独立的 DSH 工具**，注册方式、工具名、参数、代码、危险标记全部不变；
- 包只做两件事：把工具在页面里归到一起、以及**一键启停**（等价于逐个改它们的启用标记）。

### 5.1 在页面里用

1. 点顶部 `新建工具包`，填名称和描述，在「包里的工具」里勾选要放进去的工具；
2. 保存后列表里出现这个工具包的卡片，勾选的工具显示在它下面；
3. 卡片头的开关**一键启用/停用整包**：全部启用时开、全部停用时空、部分启用时显示「部分启用」并可一键全部打开；
4. 工具要换包：编辑工具 → 「所属工具包」下拉选另一个包（或选「不放入工具包」）；
5. 删除工具包只是取消分组：包里的工具**全部保留**，变回「未分组工具」。

> 包和工具是「一个工具最多属于一个包」的关系（成员关系记在工具记录上），所以改包名不会影响任何工具。

### 5.2 什么时候用

- 工具多起来以后按用途分类：`文本处理`、`数据处理`、`运维脚本`……；
- 调试某批工具时整包停掉，避免它们出现在模型的工具列表里；需要时整包打开。

### 5.3 AI 主动解锁模式（deferred tool loading）

通用叫法是 **deferred tool loading（工具延迟加载）/ progressive tool disclosure（渐进式工具披露）**；Anthropic 侧叫 Tool Search / `defer_loading`，OpenAI Responses 侧叫 deferred tools。插件用的是 DSH 内核自带的「会话中途增加工具」通道：**解锁只改变当前 agent 的可见性，不重新注册工具**。

开启方式：页面顶部「设置」→ 打开「AI 主动解锁模式」。

开启后：

1. 每个对话初始只看到两个自定义工具：
   - `custom_tool_manage`（管理工具/工具包）
   - `custom_tool_unlock`（解锁工具包）
2. 包里的工具默认**不可见、不可调用**；AI 调 `custom_tool_unlock` 的 `action="unlock"`、`pack="包名"` 后，包内启用的工具在**下一轮请求**出现。
3. **不同对话单独解锁**：解锁状态按 session id 记在 `unlocks.json`；新对话 / 子代理不会继承。DSH 重启或插件重挂载后会按文件恢复。
4. **始终解锁**：编辑工具包 → 打开「始终解锁（所有对话可见）」。这个包在任何对话里都无需解锁，适合常用工具。也可以让 AI 用 `custom_tool_manage` 的 `pack_update` 传 `alwaysUnlocked=true`。
5. **未分组工具**：编辑工具 → 把它放进某个工具包是推荐做法。若确实要保留未分组，可在「设置」里打开「允许单独解锁未分组工具」，然后 AI 用 `custom_tool_unlock` 的 `tool="工具名"` 单独解锁；关闭这个开关时，未分组工具不能单独解锁，只能放进工具包。
6. 关闭解锁模式：所有启用工具立即恢复可见；`unlocks.json` 里的记录保留，下次开启继续生效。
7. **工具包清单会注入上下文**：插件注册了一段动态运行上下文（`ctx.systemPrompt.context`），把当前工具包、成员名与未分组工具写进每个模型步骤的提示里，AI 不用先调 `action="list"` 就知道有什么可解锁。文本每次组装时重建，改包/改开关下一轮即生效；解锁模式关闭时不注入，避免无意义 token。

注意：

- 这是**可见性/上下文管理**，不是权限边界。危险工具即使被解锁，每次执行仍然走 DSH 内置审批。
- 解锁/锁定不会改变工具的启用状态；要停用整包请用工具包开关或 `pack_set_enabled`。
- 可见工具集变化会让该对话的提示前缀缓存失效一次，这是解锁的固有成本。
- 插件重挂载（bundle 禁用→启用）时，旧掩码会先释放、再按 `unlocks.json` 重建，不会出现「解锁了却仍不可见」的叠加。
